**About the Role:**

**What You’ll Do:**

jobs.desc:
**Bellows Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical** is looking for a persistent, detail-oriented HVAC Sales Follow-Up Specialist to join our team. Your primary mission is to rescue unsold revenue by systematically reviewing, analyzing, and re-engaging past HVAC bids and estimates that did not immediately close.

You will act as a detective and a closer. You will review open proposals, identify why the customer hesitated, and re-establish contact via phone, text, and email to address their objections, offer fresh incentives, and successfully close the deal.

Key Responsibilities

* **Pipeline Mining:** Review CRM software daily to identify expired, pending, or unsold HVAC replacement and repair estimates.
* **Customer Re-Engagement:** Conduct high-volume outbound outreach (calls, emails, texts) to past leads to uncover their current heating/cooling needs.
* **Objection Handling:** Diagnose why the initial bid wasn't accepted (e.g., price, timing, competitor, lack of financing) and provide strategic solutions to overcome those hurdles.
* **Strategic Discounting & Incentives:** Utilize approved financing options, seasonal rebates, or targeted promotions to incentivize hesitant buyers to move forward.
* **Deal Closing:** Resubmit updated proposals, negotiate final terms within company guidelines, and securely close the contract.
* **Data Integrity:** Update customer profiles in the CRM with accurate notes regarding why bids were won or lost to help improve future sales strategies.
* **Team Collaboration:** Coordinate with Comfort Advisors (sales reps) and Technicians to understand the technical scope of older bids before contacting the customer.

Qualifications & Skills

* **Experience:** Minimum of 1–2 years in outbound sales, account reactivation, inside sales, or telemarketing. Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or home services is highly preferred but not required.
* **Sales Acumen:** Proven ability to handle rejection, ask probing questions, and confidently

jobs.desc:
**Silicon Valley Builders Group · San Jose, CA · Full-time, on-site**

Every permit we pull has to be closed out properly. A permit left open on a finished job can block a homeowner’s next remodel or hold up our next project at that property. We’re adding a coordinator who will own the whole permit process, from application to final inspection, so that nothing gets lost after the crews leave.

**About us**  
Silicon Valley Builders Group is a general contractor serving homeowners associations and residential communities across the South Bay. We handle everything from quick repair work orders to multi-building renovations: siding, decks, waterproofing, painting, structural repairs and more. Our office team works alongside bilingual field crews, and the company is growing.

**About the role**  
In your first year, you’ll build and run our permit system. Every active permit will be tracked from application through final sign-off. You’ll find and close out the older permits that are still open. You’ll catch special inspections early, and closeout paperwork won’t hold up a final. You’ll be the person project managers, engineers and city staff call when they need to know where a permit stands. When permit work is slow, you’ll support our other project coordinators on job setup and paperwork.

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare, submit and track permit applications across multiple city and county online portals, including fees, plan sets, corrections and resubmittals.
* Schedule inspections with project managers and keep a clear record of each one: requested, passed, failed or still open.
* Spot special inspection requirements (such as welding or epoxy anchors) during the permit process, and gather the required sign-offs.
* Track closeout documents by unit or address, including smoke/CO affidavits and disposal/recycling paperwork. Follow up with homeowners, property managers and boards until everything is in.
* Work with engineers so plan sets meet each city’s submission rules

* Growing company with room to build your own book of business

Given the complexity of payroll in the construction industry, understanding prevailing wage laws, union agreements, different pay rates, and compliance with labor regulations is vital for a Payroll Coordinator. **Accounts receivable and lender draws**

* Prepare owner billings on cost-plus jobs, with the supporting cost detail the contract requires

jobs.desc:
**Overview:**

This is a high pressure job, and a great one.

Our Project Coordinator keeps every signed job moving, from contract to final invoice: roof replacements and repairs, insurance claims, water and mold losses, commercial and property management work, solar, and interior rebuilds, all at once. The phone does not stop, homeowners want answers today, adjusters take their time, and crews need materials yesterday.

It sounds busy, and it is. We are also constantly growing and improving our AI team to take repetitive tasks and communication follow up off your plate, so your time goes to the work that needs a person. If that sounds like your kind of day, keep reading.

**What You Will Do:**

* Schedule production across our crews and subcontractors, and make sure the paperwork is complete before a job goes on the calendar.
* Coordinate our sales reps’ schedules and our supervision schedule: inspections, appointments, and supervisor site visits at start, during the job, and at final walk.
* Order measurements and materials, and sequence the other trades on restoration jobs: flooring, drywall, paint, cabinets, HVAC, packout and abatement.
* Keep every job file current in AccuLynx. If it is not in AccuLynx, it did not happen.
* Keep insurance jobs moving: work with adjusters, carriers and third parties, and gather the photos and documents a supplement needs.
* Review subcontractor and supplier invoices, and keep job costs lined up between AccuLynx and QuickBooks.
* Be the customer’s day to day contact, often during the worst week of their year. Stay calm and keep them informed.
* Handle change orders, close jobs out, and work every day alongside our AI team.

*Why it is hard:* Volume surges in hail and monsoon season, constant interruptions, and real accountability. A missed delivery or a missed line on a supplement costs money and a customer’s trust.

The expert 3D CAD Records & Data Analyst serves as a key liaison between the Records team, Engineering groups, and program leadership within Gas Transmission Engineering and Design. This role supports the integration of 3D modeling into project workflows while managing the end-to-end records lifecycle for engineering deliverables, including check-in/check-out protocols, version control, and data integrity across systems. The Analyst will coordinate SAP tasks related to drawing custody and work order management, maintain and enhance reporting dashboards, and support cross-functional collaboration between engineering, drafting, construction, and records teams. jobs.desc: Full-time | Nirvana Robotics builds humanoid robots with robotic arms that work in industrial environments. Mechanical Engineer ($230K-$260K): mechanical design of robotic arms and manipulators: joints, actuators, transmissions, end effectors. GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, SolidWorks (or Creo/NX/Onshape). Apply: https://app.niuro.io/source/H4yYHesP?ref=ps_EBRp88zU7jcdRZm8... Electrical Engineer ($220K-$250K): electrical architecture for arms and humanoids: power distribution, motor-driver boards, sensor PCBs, harnessing. Apply: https://app.niuro.io/source/BeVx3CrN?ref=ps_5biniQ0FTotNxfmT... Robotic Controls Engineer ($270K-$300K): low-level control for multi-DOF arms: joint-level actuation, impedance/admittance and whole-body control, sim-to-real. PID/LQR/state-space, MoveIt or cuRobo, C++ and Python, ROS 2. Apply: https://app.niuro.io/source/gUNqx8Lj?ref=ps_BdIAhZPrP7yQt2P4... For all three: hands-on work on real robot hardware (arms, grippers, mobile manipulators, actuated joints or humanoids). Mechanical and Electrical: 5+ years with a bachelor's or 3+ with a master's. Controls: roughly BS + 4 years, MS + 2 or a PhD. US-based; relocation to NYC within the US is supported. Visa sponsorship is not available.

**Vici Construction · Sherrills Ford, NC · Full-time · $25–32/hour**

**What this job actually is**

We are a construction company. You would run the office side of it — permits, payroll, invoicing, vendor and material orders, tool inventory, and getting new crew members set up and ready to work on day one. When the office work is handled you will be in a company truck: marking locates, dropping a sign at a job we are starting, running materials out to a crew.

* Sourcing trade, material, and maintenance vendors
* Keeping the crew schedule current in our system
* Certificates of insurance current for every active sub and vendor
* Pulling lien agents and keeping project documentation filed

Sales Representative

Respure is seeking an energetic, motivated, and self-driven **Sales Representative** to join our growing team.

This is a **commission-based door-to-door sales position** focused on helping homeowners find water treatment solutions that fit their needs. Respure is a family-owned company providing residential water filtration and treatment products, including **reverse osmosis systems, water softeners, and filtered water units**.

Our products range from moderate- to high-ticket purchases, with typical commissions of approximately **$64–$400+ per household**, depending on the product sold and your commission rate.

A Major Benefit: 90-Day Customer Attribution

When you visit a home and speak with the homeowner, **you receive credit for qualifying purchases made by that homeowner within 90 days of your visit**.

That means you can earn a commission even if the homeowner doesn't make a purchase during your initial conversation. If they decide to purchase later, **you can still receive your commission**.

Commission rates typically range from **8%–10%**, depending on experience and qualifications.

Responsibilities

* Conduct door-to-door sales and introduce homeowners to Respure's products and services.
* Explain our water treatment solutions clearly, accurately, and confidently.
* Identify customer needs and recommend appropriate products.
* Build positive relationships with homeowners and potential customers.

jobs.title: Construction Estimator & Inside Sales
jobs.desc:
About Diamond

Founded in 1974, Diamond Concrete Sawing is one of the Midwest's most trusted concrete sawing and cutting companies. We are family owned, based in Grand Rapids with branches around the state, and our locating work runs under Diamond Locating Services. We saw, drill, and cut concrete on some of the most demanding projects in Michigan, including a lot of MDOT highway and public works, and we locate what is underneath before anyone digs.

We are a company of about 30 people. That means no layers to work through and no waiting a week on a decision. You will know everyone here by name, including the operators running the work you quote.

The Role

This is an estimating and quoting role first, and a sales role second. Every quote at Diamond runs through this seat, whether it came from our outside sales rep, our Director of Service, a bid board, or a contractor who called in cold. The number has to be right, and it has to go out the same day.

You own a job from the moment it is found until it is sold and handed to Service. The first phone call, the questions that define the scope, the quote, the follow-up, and the handoff to dispatch all sit with you. You are the first impression most customers get of us.

The phone rings all day and priorities move. This seat fields inbound calls and email requests, carries a large book of open quotes at a time, and one crew hitting something unexpected in the field can reshuffle your afternoon. If you want a predictable desk, this is not it.

What You Will Do

* Own inbound customer requests and respond the same day.
* Confirm scope, location, access, timing, and special requirements before you quote. Call the client back the same day for anything missing, and ask the questions that change the number.
* Prepare and send quotes for the whole team.
* Follow up on every open quote you own until it is won or lost, and review the losses to find out why.
* Seek out new work daily through bid platforms and other lead sources.
*

**Not sure what you want to do for a career? That's okay.**

Most people don't grow up thinking about a career in mechanical construction. But it's a huge industry with some great opportunities, and you don't need a college degree or construction experience to get started.

We're a family-owned mechanical construction company with over 400 employees, and we're looking for someone who's ready to learn, work hard, and figure out where they want to go.

What's the Job?

You'll work directly with our project managers, estimators, and field supervisors to help keep construction projects running smoothly.

Some days you'll be tracking down materials or checking on orders. Other days you'll be helping set up new projects, working in Excel, or figuring out how to solve a problem.

A lot of it is behind-the-scenes work, but it's how you'll learn the business.

**We're not expecting you to know how to do all of this. We'll teach you.**

We're less concerned about your résumé and more interested in how you approach work.

* You show up, follow through, and do what you say you'll do.
* You're comfortable with computers and willing to learn Excel.
* You can figure things out instead of waiting for someone to give you every answer.
* You ask questions when you don't understand something.
* You take pride in doing a good job, even with the small stuff.

**No construction experience required. No college degree required. Just bring a good attitude and a willingness to learn.**

Where Can This Lead?

This doesn't have to be your forever job.

You'll get exposure to different parts of the construction business, and if you show initiative and pick things up quickly, there are real opportunities to move into roles like **Project Management or Estimating.**

We're looking for someone who wants to grow into more responsibility, not necessarily someone who wants to be an assistant for the next 10 years.

**About SWI Digital**

SWI Digital is the US digital-infrastructure platform of SWI Group, a Euronext Amsterdam-listed investment group with roughly $12 billion of assets under management. Formed from SWI Group's controlling acquisition of Genesis Digital Assets, SWI Digital holds an energized, grid-connected land bank and develops large-scale data center capacity for AI and high-performance computing in the world's largest market for that demand.

**The Role**

On a self-perform data center program, the schedule is not a report. It is the plan the field builds to, the basis for every trade buyout and equipment commitment, and the document the tenant, the lenders, and the investment committee hold us to. The Scheduler owns that plan for SWI Digital's campuses.

This is an owner's-side role inside the project delivery organization. You will build and maintain the integrated master schedule for each campus in Primavera P6, tying together site work, on-site power and energization, shell and MEP construction, long-lead equipment deliveries, permits, commissioning, and tenant ready-for-service dates. You will be the final authority on logic and float, you will defend the plan to project executives and leadership, and when a site starts to slip you will have the recovery scenario ready before anyone asks for it.

**What You'll Own**

* **Integrated master schedule** — Build and maintain the P6 master schedule for each campus from pre-construction through turnover: WBS, activity logic, calendars, constraints, resource loading where it matters, and a critical path that reflects how the site will actually be built.

* **Schedule integrity** — Be the final word on logic and float. Run DCMA 14-point or equivalent health checks on every update, keep the baseline controlled, and defend the plan to project executives, trade partners, and leadership.

**Job Description:** Construction Controller

**About the Role**

We are an outsourced accounting and controller services firm serving construction and home service businesses with $2M–$20M in annual revenue. Our clients are owner-operators — they build homes, remodel kitchens, install HVAC, run service crews. They are excellent at their trade and they need someone who is excellent at the numbers.

As a Construction Controller, you are the financial leader for a portfolio of client businesses. You sit across from the owner and tell them what the numbers mean and what to do about it. You own the relationship, the systems, and the outcome — even when the day-to-day bookkeeping is executed by someone else on your team.

**Who Thrives Here**

* **You learn fast.** Show you something once and you've got it. When you hit something you've never done, you find the answer, build the checklist, and don't need to be shown twice.

* **You fix the process, not just the problem.** When something takes too long or breaks twice, you redesign it — an import, a template, an integration, a better handoff.
* **You're comfortable with technology.** You can tell us what syncs cleanly from JobTread or Buildertrend into QBO and what doesn't, and you pick up new tools quickly.

**About Professional Diversified Flooring, Inc.**

Professional Diversified Flooring was established in 1981 and is a leading provider of commercial flooring solutions. With a workforce exceeding 70 office employees and over 400 field labor, the company specializes in comprehensive flooring services for commercial spaces throughout Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Las Vegas, Phoenix, and surrounding areas. Our portfolio encompasses a wide range of projects, from corporate offices to casinos and from healthcare to hospitality, positioning us not merely as flooring specialists, but as strategic partners in design and construction adding maximum value to our clients and their clients.

**THE ROLE**
------------

Billing at PDF does two things: it bills, and it collects. The Billing Specialist owns both, end to end, for the projects assigned to them — from verifying the contract, through progress billing, pay applications, portal submission, lien releases and retention, to collecting the money and closing the job.

Roughly 60% of your time is billing, 30% is collecting, and 10% is the compliance paperwork that gates payment in construction. You are the customer-facing voice of our accounting department to General Contractor project accountants and End User AP teams, and the person our Project Managers rely on to turn finished work into cash.

This is not a data-entry job. The volume is real — a proficient specialist produces 150–200 billings and around $3 million a month — but the work is judgment: reading a subcontract's billing terms, knowing how much can reasonably be billed on a job, catching an over-billing before the GC does, and knowing how far to push a collection before escalating.

You will report to our Billing Manager and work alongside a small, tight team in our Irvine office

**​Job Summary ​**

**We are seeking a reliable, safety-conscious Ready-Mix Concrete Driver to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for batching support, loading, transporting, and delivering ready-mix concrete to commercial, residential, and infrastructure job sites. You will serve as a primary point of contact on delivery sites, ensuring high-quality customer service, precise slump delivery, and strict adherence to safety standards.**

**On-Site Operations: Safely maneuver vehicles on uneven terrain and tight construction sites. Assemble, attach, and clean discharge chutes to pour concrete into forms, pump hoppers, or wheelbarrows.**

**Vehicle Maintenance & Care: Perform required Pre-Trip and Post-Trip inspections (DVIR). Keep the mixer drum, hopper, and exterior washed down to prevent concrete buildup. Report mechanical issues promptly. ​**

**Customer Service & Communication: Maintain professional communication with dispatchers, plant operators, site superintendents, and contractors. Secure signed delivery tickets or electronic receipts. ​**

**Safety Compliance: Adhere to all OSHA, DOT, company, and site-specific safety rules, including wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times. ​**

**Qualifications & Requirements ​Driver's License: Active Class A or Class B Commercial Driver's License (CDL) with an acceptable driving record. (Tanker endorsement or Air Brakes endorsement may be required). ​Medical Certification: Current DOT Medical Card (or ability to pass a DOT physical and drug screen). ​**

**Job Description**

Marwood General Construction is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned heavy civil contractor working federal, municipal, and private civil projects across Kitsap and the surrounding counties. We self perform our work. Earthwork, utilities, structures, paving, site clearing, concrete flatwork, demolition, and hauling. We own our iron and we run our own dirt.

This position is a dual hat seat with real ownership. You take a job from bid invitation through award, then carry that same job through buyout, execution, and closeout. You are accountable for the margin you wrote into it.

That structure is deliberate. Estimators who never build their own work develop expensive blind spots. We want someone who has to live with their numbers, because that is what makes a number honest.

A lot of our people are veterans, and it shows in how we run. We hire self starters who can move without direct supervision, make a sound call, own the outcome, and tell us straight what happened. We are small enough that this hire will visibly move the company, and established enough that the work is already there. You will not be a cog in an estimating department. You will build it.

Duties

**Estimating**

* Own bids end to end. ITB review, site visit, quantity takeoff, unit pricing, subcontractor and vendor solicitation, bid day close, and closeout feedback back into the cost library.
* Price earthwork, utilities, structures, and paving for federal, municipal, and private civil work in the $500K to $10M range.
* Build production rate based pricing from crew composition, equipment fleet cost, and realistic daily output. Not gut feel and not a marked up unit price book.

jobs.desc:
**About Marex Services Group**

Marex Services Group is a technology-enabled logistics company delivering high-impact transportation solutions across industrial, construction, energy, infrastructure, and specialized project markets. Our Finished Goods division runs domestic open-deck trucking for precast concrete, fabricated pipe, steel, scaffolding, and other construction materials. We move fast, execute with precision, and operate with accountability.

At Marex, performance matters. Ownership matters. Execution matters.

**Read This First: The Schedule and the Pace**

This role works **Saturday through Wednesday**, every week, with Thursday and Friday off. This is a set schedule, not a rotation, so please apply only if a weekend workweek fits your life.

* Volume: You will help move 60+ loads per day. The desk is busy from start to finish, and juggling many shipments at once is the job.
* Weekends: On Saturdays and Sundays you are the Finished Goods desk. You run the day on your own, with an on-call manager available for escalations and decisions above your authority. Once you are trained, you can work weekend shifts from home if you prefer.
* Weekdays: Monday through Wednesday you work alongside the full team, which is where most of your training and coaching happens.

**What a week could look like once you're ramped up:** Saturday and Sunday from about 5:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., and Monday through Wednesday from about 1:00 to 6:00 p.m. Hours during training may differ, and they may shift as the desk and the business grow.

For the right person, the schedule is a plus: weekdays off for appointments and errands, and real ownership of the desk early in your career.

**Position Overview**

The Logistics Coordinator keeps a high-volume open-deck desk moving. You will book, track, and close out spot and project loads of precast, pipe, steel, and scaffolding, and you will be the first person carriers and customers hear from when something changes.

This is an early-career

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Summary**

An established Southern California general contractor is seeking an experienced Estimator to support healthcare, institutional, and commercial construction projects throughout the region.

This role focuses on early-stage estimating, conceptual budgeting, constructability reviews, and preconstruction planning. Projects include healthcare tenant improvements, hospital renovations, seismic upgrades, infrastructure improvements, and select ground-up construction.

The ideal candidate has estimating experience with a general contractor, preferably within HCAI/OSHPD healthcare construction, and is comfortable evaluating project costs, identifying potential risks, and working directly with clients and internal project teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare conceptual estimates, ROM (rough order of magnitude) budgets, and detailed project cost estimates
* Evaluate project feasibility, anticipated costs, and potential risks during early planning stages
* Review plans, specifications, and construction documents for scope, constructability, and cost considerations
* Provide timely preliminary pricing and budget recommendations for prospective projects
* Participate in preconstruction meetings with clients, architects, engineers, and project teams
* Review project schedules, phasing requirements, site logistics, and construction sequencing
* Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost savings
* Evaluate subcontractor pricing and develop cost comparisons as needed
* Support estimating efforts for HCAI/OSHPD healthcare renovations, seismic upgrades, and infrastructure projects
* Coordinate with project management and operations teams throughout preconstruction and project turnover
* Maintain accurate estimating records, budgets, and cost data

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of estimating or preconstruction experience, preferably with a general contractor
* Experience with HCAI/OSHPD healthcare construction strongly preferred

headlined_rolled.desc:
Job Description:

Schneider Electric is seeking a **Construction Estimator** to support the development and execution of complex construction and energy projects.

In this role, you will partner closely with Engineering, Project Management, Sales, Operations, Procurement, suppliers, and subcontractors to develop accurate and competitive project estimates. You will review project requirements, develop cost estimates, evaluate subcontractor and supplier pricing, assess constructability, and identify key cost assumptions and risks throughout the project development process.

This is a highly collaborative role for an experienced construction professional who combines strong estimating and analytical skills with the ability to work effectively across technical, commercial, and customer-facing teams.

**What will you do?**

* Develop Class 2 and Class 3 cost estimates for mechanical, electrical, plumbing, site, and building construction scopes.
* Review plans, specifications, engineering scopes, site information, and other available project documentation to develop accurate estimates.
* Prepare estimates throughout the project lifecycle, including preliminary/ROM, conceptual, estimate-grade design, and construction-level estimates.
* Perform quantity take-offs, develop pricing, document assumptions and risks, and evaluate subcontractor and supplier proposals.
* Solicit and evaluate vendor and subcontractor pricing to support competitive and complete project estimates.
* Provide constructability input, including guidance on project phasing, means and methods, and potential cost impacts.
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Procurement, and project teams throughout the estimating and project development process.
* Participate in site surveys, design reviews, project handoffs, and other project development activities as needed.
* Support procurement and tender activities during project development and construction.

* Develop project budgets and detailed estimates for commercial construction projects.
* Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings to determine project scope, quantities, and pricing.

* Participate in site visits, pre-bid meetings, and client discussions to clarify project requirements.

* Transition awarded projects to the operations team, communicating budgets, scope details, and estimating assumptions.

* Experience estimating commercial renovations, tenant improvements, interior build-outs, and/or ground-up construction.
* Strong understanding of construction costs, labor productivity, materials, and subcontractor pricing.
* Ability to interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings, specifications, and contract documents.

headlined_rolled.desc:
Construction Project Coordinator

**Company:** Jackson Construction Ltd.  
**Location:** Fort Worth, TX  
**Pay:** $24.00–$34.00 per hour (suggested range; confirm before publishing)  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Setting:** On-site

Job Description

Jackson Construction Ltd. is seeking an organized and motivated Construction Project Coordinator to support construction planning, scheduling, documentation, and project communication in Fort Worth, Texas. The successful candidate will work closely with project managers, subcontractors, suppliers, and field teams to help ensure construction activities progress efficiently and meet established deadlines.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates effectively, and can coordinate multiple project tasks while maintaining accurate records.

Responsibilities

* Assist project managers with construction planning, scheduling, and daily coordination.
* Maintain project files, contracts, permits, drawings, and other construction documents.
* Coordinate communication among subcontractors, suppliers, field personnel, and management.
* Track project milestones, deadlines, material deliveries, and outstanding tasks.

headlined_rolled.title: Estimator / Project Manager (Heavy Civil)
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Description**

Marwood General Construction is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned heavy civil contractor working federal, municipal, and private civil projects across Kitsap and the surrounding counties. We self perform our work. Earthwork, utilities, structures, paving, site clearing, concrete flatwork, demolition, and hauling. We own our iron and we run our own dirt.

Our market runs in three lanes. Federal work through NAVFAC and Naval Base Kitsap is a growing part of our pipeline. Municipal and public agency work is steady. Private commercial site development rounds it out. We are also OMWBE certified and a participant in the WSDOT Capacity Building Mentorship Program.

This position is a dual hat seat with real ownership. You take a job from bid invitation through award, then carry that same job through buyout, execution, and closeout. You are accountable for the margin you wrote into it.

That structure is deliberate. Estimators who never build their own work develop expensive blind spots. We want someone who has to live with their numbers, because that is what makes a number honest.

A lot of our people are veterans, and it shows in how we run. We hire self starters who can move without direct supervision, make a sound call, own the outcome, and tell us straight what happened. We are small enough that this hire will visibly move the company, and established enough that the work is already there. You will not be a cog in an estimating department. You will build it.

Duties

**Estimating**

* Own bids end to end. ITB review, site visit, quantity takeoff, unit pricing, subcontractor and vendor solicitation, bid day close, and closeout feedback back into the cost library.
* Price earthwork, utilities, structures, and paving for federal, municipal, and private civil work in the $500K to $10M range.
* Build production rate based pricing from crew composition, equipment fleet cost, and realistic daily output. Not gut feel and not a marked up unit price book.

headlined_rolled.title: Plumbing dispatcher csr
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Overview**

As a Plumbing Dispatcher and Customer Service Representative (CSR), you’ll keep service calls moving and customers informed. You’ll answer incoming calls, gather clear details about plumbing needs, schedule appointments, and coordinate technician dispatch. Your organized approach will help connect customers with timely service while keeping the team aligned.

Your impact: Accurate scheduling and clear communication help customers understand what to expect and help technicians arrive prepared.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage calls on a multi-line phone system with professional phone etiquette and attentive customer service.
* Schedule and dispatch plumbing technicians using dispatch or vehicle dispatch software; update records through accurate data entry and typing.
* Coordinate internal communication about appointments, service updates, and changing priorities.
* Track vehicles and service routes using GPS (Global Positioning System); apply relevant knowledge of logistics, fleet management, road transportation operations, and transportation planning.
* Support related coordination involving supply chain, freight, shipping and receiving, and transportation management systems, including Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), as applicable.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication, phone communication, organizational, and analysis skills; able to manage calls and details accurately in a fast-paced setting.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning dispatch and transportation management systems.
* Experience with dispatching, customer service, logistics, or transportation management is preferred.
* Familiarity with GIS (geographic information systems), GPS, DOT (Department of Transportation) regulations, and road transportation operations is helpful.
* Knowledge of supply chain, freight, shipping and receiving, transportation planning, or fleet management is a plus.

Pay: $16.90 - $20.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Admiral Heating has been a trusted leader in commercial and industrial HVAC solutions in the Chicagoland area for over 70 years. The Chief Estimator is responsible for leading, managing and holding accountable a team of estimators who together are responsible for estimating approximately $400 million of HVAC projects including tenant improvement and design build including Sheetmetal, Piping and Commissioning. The Chief Estimator will work closely with the sales team on tracking and completing all bids in a timely manner while also working closely with the operations team on handing off projects awarded.

* Lead and oversee the estimating function, setting priorities, review standards, and bid governance from opportunity evaluation through final submission and turnover.

* Provide executive oversight of estimate quality, pricing assumptions

**Overview**

As a Construction Office Manager, you’ll keep the administrative and financial operations of a construction office organized and moving forward. You’ll coordinate schedules, support project teams, manage office workflows, and communicate with clients and vendors. Your impact: Accurate records and timely coordination help project teams stay focused and clients receive clear, dependable updates.

* Manage calendars, schedules, front desk coverage, multi-line phone systems, and professional phone etiquette.
* Oversee bookkeeping, accounting, payroll, budgeting, and financial software tasks, including QuickBooks.
* Coordinate vendor management, event planning, filing, spreadsheets, and Microsoft Office documentation.
* Support human resources, confidential information handling, and training and development.
* Provide customer service and client communication while supervising and supporting office staff.

**Requirements**

* Office management, administrative, clerical, or general office experience; accounting and finance experience is preferred.
* Experience with QuickBooks or other accounting software, financial software, bookkeeping, payroll, and spreadsheets.
* Supervising, team management, or training experience; familiarity with schedule management, budgeting, and vendor coordination.
* Strong communication, organizational, and technical proficiency, with sound judgment handling confidential information.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, filing, calendar management, front desk duties, and multi-line phone systems; event planning and customer service skills are valued.

headlined_rolled.desc:
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) works with a Project Manager in running the day-to-day project management operations on a project.

**GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES**
============================

* **Project Set Up:** Set proper tools in place prior to the beginning of a project, collaborating with project team to ensure profitability and client satisfaction. (General conditions, buy schedule and strategy, etc.)

* **Financial Management:** Ensure that jobs are set up properly to meet established profit goals by analyzing and integrating all business and contractual terms.
* **Relationship Management:** Develop critical relationships with client, design team, field team, subcontractors, and vendors.

**REQUIREMENTS**
================

* Bachelor's degree in applicable discipline
* 3 years of related experience in construction industry preferred
* Ability to manage, embrace change, respond, and adapt
* Experience with the following preferred: ground-up and fit-outs, occupied spaces, retail spaces, restaurants, corporate interiors, etc.
* Experience working with Procore preferred
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office

**About Us**

Atlantic Sitton is an established liquid waste service company. We pump septic systems and grease traps, install and repair septic systems, and handle emergency calls for residential and commercial customers across New Jersey. * Calm under pressure and able to juggle many moving pieces at once
* Strong phone presence and clear, professional communication with customers and drivers
* Comfortable with dispatch or scheduling software, Google Maps or routing tools, and basic computer work
* Reliable, organized, and detail-oriented

**Schedule**

* Full-time, Monday–Friday, day shift

There may be opportunity for this role to convert to regular full-time classification in 2027. The Accounting Assistant supports accurate and timely accounting operations across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. This role reviews and enters invoices, assists with vendor payments, prepares customer billings, applies incoming payments, maintains organized records, and helps reconcile accounts. This entry-level position is ideal for a detail-oriented individual who is eager to build broad accounting experience in a fast-paced construction environment. This position is based in Alameda, CA and reports to the Controller.

* Protect confidential financial, customer, vendor, and company information.

headlined_rolled.desc:
BEI Construction is seeking a hands-on Payroll Manager to lead payroll operations and support the implementation of BEI’s new payroll and timekeeping software. This role is responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, compliance, and continuous improvement of payroll for union and non-union employees. The Payroll Manager supervises the Payroll Specialist and works closely with the Controller and Accounting team on payroll funding, reporting, reconciliations, job costing, audits, and internal controls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead payroll workstreams for BEI’s payroll/timekeeping software implementation, including configuration support, testing, parallel payroll, data validation, reporting, training, and post-launch stabilization.
* Oversee accurate, timely weekly payroll for union and non-union employees, including regular payroll, off-cycle payroll, adjustments, final pay, deductions, garnishments, reimbursements, and employee changes.
* Supervise and support the Payroll Specialist; assign priorities, review work, resolve escalations, and maintain consistent payroll procedures and controls.
* Partner with the Controller and Accounting team on payroll funding, payroll taxes, job costing, labor allocation, reconciliations, reporting, audits, internal controls, and system-related process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with wage and hour requirements, union rules, prevailing wage, certified payroll, public works requirements, payroll tax rules, recordkeeping, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
* Resolve payroll discrepancies, timekeeping issues, employee pay questions, agency notices, and related payroll inquiries.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of progressive payroll experience, including hands-on payroll management and team leadership.

* Experience with complex payroll environments required; construction, union payroll, prevailing wage, certified payroll, public works, multi-rate, or multi-state payroll experience strongly preferred.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

As an HVAC Estimator, you’ll turn construction plans and project requirements into clear, accurate estimates for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning work. You’ll review drawings, assess material and labor needs, develop project budgets, and support pricing and contract discussions. Your work will help teams plan effectively and give clients a reliable understanding of project costs.

Your impact: Accurate estimates help project teams control costs and help clients make informed decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* Review construction drawings and technical documents to define HVAC scope and estimate material requirements.
* Prepare project budgets, pricing, and cost estimates for commercial and residential construction; support cost management and cost control.
* Use estimating software and spreadsheets to organize takeoffs, assumptions, and estimate details.
* Coordinate with project teams and clients, communicate estimate findings, and support negotiations and contract review.
* Apply construction site experience and construction management knowledge to assess project conditions and manage estimating work.

**Requirements**

* Construction estimating experience, including estimating commercial construction projects and managing projects as a construction estimator.
* Ability to read blueprints, review construction drawings, interpret technical drawings, and estimate material costs and requirements.
* Experience in the construction industry; construction experience is essential, while construction site experience is preferred.

**Job Summary**

The Bookkeeper maintains accurate and up-to-date financial records for multiple entities. This includes recording day-to-day financial transactions, reconciling accounts, maintaining clean separation between entities, and supporting the Accounting Manager through month-end close.

Because this role works across multiple related entities and has visibility into ownership-level financial information, discretion and sound judgment are as essential to the job as technical accuracy.

**Core Accountability**

The Bookkeeper is accountable for the accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions in the general ledgers of the companies; for ensuring expenses are coded to the correct entity, account, and job; and for keeping financial records organized, audit-ready, and maintained in accordance with company processes.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Records daily financial transactions, including purchases, receipts, and payments, in the accounting system.
* Maintains the general ledger and posts journal entries as directed.
* Codes invoices and expenses to the correct entity, general ledger account, and job cost code.
* Maintains clean separation between entities and records intercompany transactions and allocations accurately.
* Reconciles bank, credit card, and vendor statements monthly and resolves discrepancies.
* Supports accounts payable and accounts receivable as needed, including entering invoices and applying customer payments.
* Reviews and reconciles employee expense reports and company credit card transactions.
* Maintains vendor records and supports annual 1099 preparation.
* Assists with month-end and year-end close, including preparing supporting schedules and account reconciliations.
* Prepares basic financial reports and account summaries for accounting leadership.

**Junior Concrete Estimator — Training Provided**  
**Brandonbilt | Fredericksburg, Virginia**  
**Salary: $50,000 per year**

Brandonbilt is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented person to join our team as a concrete estimator. Construction or estimating experience is a plus, but we are open to training the right candidate.

We complete concrete projects for builders and homeowners, including footers, foundations, basements, flatwork, waterproofing, and walls.

* Review plans and project information to understand the scope of work.
* Learn to calculate material quantities, labor needs, and project costs.
* Prepare estimates and proposals.
* Communicate with builders, homeowners, suppliers, and our team to clarify project details.

* Strong basic math skills and attention to detail.

headlined_rolled.title: Restoration Estimator - Xactimate
headlined_rolled.desc:
**About Us**  
Restoration 1 of Huntington Beach is a licensed disaster restoration and environmental remediation company (CA GC #1131316) serving Orange County. We handle water, fire, and mold mitigation and reconstruction, working directly with homeowners, insurance carriers, and adjusters. We're growing and need a sharp estimator who can write accurate, defensible Xactimate estimates that get approved and paid.

**The Role**  
You'll own the estimating process from first inspection to final approval. That means scoping losses on site, building detailed Xactimate estimates for both mitigation and reconstruction, and working with adjusters to get every legitimate line item paid.

**Responsibilities**

* Inspect water, fire, and mold losses and document damage with photos, moisture readings, and measurements
* Create floor plans and sketches in Xactimate Sketch, or using Matterport/DocuSketch
* Write complete, accurate Xactimate estimates for emergency services, mitigation, and reconstruction
* Prepare and submit supplements with supporting documentation
* Communicate and negotiate professionally with insurance adjusters and carrier desk reviewers
* Upload estimates and documentation to carrier and TPA portals (XactAnalysis, Contractor Connection, etc.)
* Review completed job files so final invoices match the work performed
* Coordinate with the field crew and office on scope, materials, and job progress
* Track estimate status, approvals, and receivables

**Requirements**

* 2+ years writing Xactimate estimates in insurance restoration (required)
* Strong knowledge of Xactimate line items, pricing, sketch, and estimate structure
* Understanding of the water mitigation process and IICRC S500/S520 standards
* Proven experience writing supplements and negotiating with adjusters
* Strong construction knowledge: drywall, flooring, cabinets, paint, trim, and so on
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple files at once
* Valid California driver's license

headlined_rolled.title: Project Scheduler
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Summary**

The Project Scheduler supports the planning, coordination, and monitoring of construction schedules across multiple projects. This role primarily focuses on assisting with schedule development during the proposal phase and partnering with superintendents and project teams to maintain, update, and improve active project schedules. The Project Scheduler plays a key role in ensuring schedules are realistic, properly maintained, and aligned with project goals and field conditions.

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Support preconstruction and estimating teams by developing preliminary schedules, milestone timelines, and phasing plans for proposals.
* Analyze drawings, specifications, and bid documents to identify scheduling constraints, risks, and sequencing considerations.
* Review and evaluate project schedules created by superintendents and project managers for logic, duration accuracy, and completeness.
* Collaborate with superintendents and project managers to update and maintain active project schedules, ensuring alignment with field progress and conditions.
* Identify potential schedule conflicts, delays, or impacts and assist project teams in developing mitigation or recovery plans.
* Facilitate and participate in regular schedule review meetings with project teams.
* Track and monitor key project milestones and schedule performance across multiple projects.
* Assist project team to prepare and distribute internal and client-facing schedule updates and reports.
* Provide guidance, direction, and support to field teams on scheduling best practices and use of scheduling tools, especially with regard to difficult project impacts. Assess the impact of design changes and schedule slippages.
* Assist in standardizing scheduling processes, templates, and reporting methods across projects.
* Support documentation and analysis related to schedule

headlined_rolled.title: Office Coordinator
headlined_rolled.desc:
Join our team as an **Office Coordinator**! Support residents and prospective residents, handle administrative tasks, process payments, assist with move-ins and move-outs, and maintain accurate community records. Help keep day-to-day operations running smoothly while contributing to a welcoming, well-managed community.

Duties and Responsibilities

What you will do:

The qualified individual will work as an integral part of the Operations and Community teams to perform the following essential job functions:

* Establish rapport with residents and prospective residents, field community comments, suggestions, and complaints, and forward to the appropriate manager.

* Prepare and distribute resident and community communications including, but not limited to rule reminders, increase letters, delinquency notices, eviction paperwork, lease addendums and renewals.

* Perform administrative and clerical functions including answering phones, typing, copying, and filing.

* Provide prospective residents with an option to see suitable homes to their needs that are in inventory; show the home(s), and then guide them through the application process.

* Collect and post resident security deposits, processing fees, rent payments, inspection fees, etc., record transactions in the ledger and issue receipts.

* Call for payment on delinquent accounts.

* Process move-ins and move-outs.

* Prepare bills and statements for approval.

* Maintain a record of all traffic logs and/or guest cards, and telephone calls.

Construction Accounting Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Company:** Carter Electric, LLC

**Position:** Construction Accounting Assistant

**Reports to:** Controller

**Position Summary**

The Construction Accounting Assistant supports the Accounting and Operations teams by managing construction-related accounting functions, including accounts receivable, progress billing, lien compliance, Notice to Owner (NTO) tracking, contract administration, and job cost reporting. This position requires experience in the construction industry and proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Accounts Receivable & Billing**

* Prepare and process progress billings, pay applications, and customer invoices.
* Review contract documents to ensure billing complies with contract terms.
* Monitor collections and follow up on outstanding customer balances.
* Apply customer payments and maintain accurate aging reports.
* Assist with monthly billing reconciliations and revenue tracking.
* Support month-end and year-end closing activities.

**Construction Contracts & Compliance**

* Prepare, track, and maintain Notice to Owner (NTO) documentation.
* Manage lien waiver collections from vendors and subcontractors.
* Monitor lien rights and filing deadlines.
* Assist with preparation and tracking of liens, releases, and related documentation.
* Maintain compliance files for subcontractors, including Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, and licensing requirements.
* Coordinate with project managers and customers to resolve contract and billing issues.

**Job Cost Accounting**

* Assist with job setup and maintenance in Sage 100 Contractor.
* Review job costs for accuracy and proper coding.
* Support project managers by providing job cost reports and financial information.
* Analyze billing versus cost-to-date on active construction projects.
* Assist with change order track

About Casa Utopia

Casa Utopia Builders Inc. (CSLB License #1091633) is a licensed general contractor building high-end custom homes, additions, ADUs and full remodels across Silicon Valley, from Saratoga and Cupertino to San Mateo and Santa Cruz County. We run several projects at once, and we treat every client's home like it's our own.

The Role

You'll work side by side with our Project Manager on every phase of a job, from proposal and permitting through framing, finishes and final walkthrough. It's a hands-on role that splits time between our Campbell office and job sites across the South Bay and Peninsula, with a clear path to running your own projects.

- Support the PM on multiple residential projects at the same time

- Prepare and update proposals, scopes of work, budgets and change orders

- Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, designers and city plan check

- Track permits, inspections and corrections through to sign-off

- Schedule and coordinate subcontractors and material deliveries

- Visit job sites to check progress, quality and safety; document with photos and daily notes

- Keep clients updated with progress photos and clear, friendly communication

- Keep project trackers, RFIs, submittals and selections files organized

What We're Looking For

- 1-3 years of experience in residential construction (GC, remodel, or new build)

- Able to read architectural and structural plans

- Organized, responsive and comfortable juggling several jobs

- Clear, professional communicator with clients and trades

- Comfortable with Google Workspace, Excel/Sheets, and construction or CRM software

- Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (travel between Bay Area job sites)

- Construction management degree or trade background is a plus

What We Offer

- $90,000 - $110,000 salary, based on experience

- Mentorship from an experienced PM and a real path to Project Manager

- Variety of high-end projects: additions, ADUs, kitchens,

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

As an AI Construction Scheduler, you’ll combine construction knowledge, project scheduling, and data analysis to build and maintain reliable project schedules. You’ll use artificial intelligence (AI) tools alongside construction management software to organize project information, identify schedule risks, and support timely decisions. Your work will help project teams coordinate plans, resources, and deadlines across civil construction projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, update, and analyze construction schedules using Primavera P6 and other scheduling software.
* Apply AI tools and project data to identify potential delays, dependencies, and schedule conflicts; validate findings against construction plans and site conditions.
* Coordinate with project managers, estimators, and field teams to align schedules with construction estimating, contracts, costs, and project plans.
* Maintain schedule and project records in construction management software, including Procore, Bluebeam, Prolog, and HeavyBid, as applicable.
* Your impact: Clear, accurate schedules help project teams anticipate constraints and coordinate work so field crews and project stakeholders can make informed decisions.

**Qualifications**

* **8-12+ years** as a construction project manager
* Experience at a general contractor, ideally a top 100-200 US GC (e.g., DPR, Turner, Gilbane, Whiting-Turner, Suffolk)
* Track record managing multiple complex projects across the US, covering both planning and execution, either managing projects directly or managing the PMs who run them
* Ability to read and understand blueprints and construction drawings
* Working knowledge of 4D scheduling software, construction project management tools, and 3D modeling/BIM software (**essential**)

Pay: $140,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA (San Francisco County)

**Summary**

The Manager, Fuel Supply and Operations will oversee generation fuel resources, including natural gas supply, transportation, and storage, ensuring the safe, reliable, and cost-effective delivery of power to members. Additionally, this position will oversee the reconciliation of fuel and economy power transactions and fuel- related commercial agreements.

**Essential Functions**

* Manage fuel requirements for generation facilities by coordinating with power dispatchers, fuel suppliers, pipelines, and storage operators.
* Manage operational programs and reporting processes for use with renewable energy resources, including hydro and wind resources.
* Oversee fuel nomination, scheduling, and balancing fuel supply over pipelines and storage systems.
* Manage operational terms of commercial agreements for natural gas supply, transportation, storage, and transactions.
* Manage commercial and operational obligations requirements associated with economic dispatch, fuel supply activities and economy power transactions.
* Develop and maintain the production cost models, fuel forecasting and annual fuel budget.
* Develop and implement processes and procedures to reconcile natural gas, other fuel resources and economy power transactions, including Power Pool.
* Assist in the development, technical analysis, and commercial terms of new gas supply and related contracts.

Clark Construction is looking for motivated and energetic Planning & Scheduling Professionals to join its expanding national team supporting commercial construction projects. The ideal candidate should be a proactive self-starter with a proven ability to work independently and efficiently, while also engaging closely with Operations Project Teams, Clark Executives, Subcontractors, and Owners.
  
  
We are looking for a Construction Project Scheduler to use their experience and ability to support planning & scheduling efforts on multiple projects. They are also expected to contribute to Corporate Initiatives including, but not limited to, training development and delivery, data analytics, trend identification and reporting.

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):

* Understand and implement accepted Planning & Scheduling Best Practices
* Analyze drawings, specifications, and statements of work in the preparation and acceptance of usable Baseline schedules for construction.
* Monitor multiple project schedules being developed and updated by Operations staff and provide guidance as necessary.
* Interact with the Operations team and represent Clark and its partners in the best manner to owners, subcontractors, and their representatives.
* Support the development of conceptual bid and proposal schedules with executive management and present to selection committees if required.
* Utilize analytics to identify and report on project trends.
* Effectively cost and manpower load schedules for use during the execution of the project.
* Evaluate the actual construction status relative to proposed plan.
* Analyze and communicate the impact of changes to the schedule.
* Prepare Time Impact Analyses per recommended practices by commonly accepted standards.
* Travel to project sites.

headlined_rolled.desc:
The Accounts Payable Specialist will be responsible for accurately processing invoices, working with Project Managers and Vendors to resolve concerns. This individual will also provide daily reception relief for the receptionist. Other accounting and administrative duties will be assigned, as needed.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Accurately reviews, codes, and inputs A/P invoices for Clarkson Construction and subsidiary companies
* Reviews all invoices and communicates with field/project management for appropriate documentation
* Prioritize invoices according to cash discount potential and payment terms
* 1099 maintenance
* Reconcile vendor statements, research and correct discrepancies; respond to all vendor inquiries
* Communicate with invoice approvers to ensure timely processing of invoices
* Assist in month-end closing
* Maintain files and documentation thoroughly and accurately, in accordance with company policy and accepted accounting practices
* Assist with other projects as needed
* Oversee proper file and data management
* Provide reception relief and accurately screen and direct callers to appropriate personnel
* Sort and distribute incoming mail
* Provide other administrative assistance, as needed

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* 1+ years of related experience or college/work equivalent
* Ability to understand and learn software/tools related to Accounts Payable quickly

**PHYSICAL AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS**

* Professional appearance and behavior
* Excellent customer service skills
* Exceptional oral and written communications
* Self-starter with ability to work independently, with advanced attention to details
* Strong time management and organizational skills
* High level of integrity, with confidentiality and discretion
* Sound judgment and problem-solving abilities

headlined_rolled.title: Plumbing Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented **Part-Time Plumbing Assistant** to support our team with sewer camera inspections, light drain cleaning, and general small plumbing maintenance tasks.

This is a great opportunity for a light-commercial/residential maintenance technician, handyman, or aspiring plumber looking for steady part-time work with flexible scheduling.

* **Sewer Scope Inspections:** Run sewer camera inspection lines through cleanouts or toilet drain entries to assess pipe condition and identify blockages or damage.
* **Toilet Pulls & Resets:** Pull toilets to gain access for camera inspections or drain clearing, then clean flanges, replace wax rings, and reinstall/reseat toilets securely.
* **Light Drain Cleaning:** Clear residential branch drain clogs using standard mechanical snakes or hand augers.
* **Small Plumbing Support:** Assist with small plumbing repairs, fixture hookups, valve replacements, and minor maintenance tasks.
* **Documentation & Clean-Up:** Record video/notes during scope inspections and ensure the workspace is left clean and protected at every job site.

* **Experience:** 1+ years of experience in plumbing assistance, property maintenance, or general home service trades.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Bookkeeper to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting principles and practices, with proficiency in various accounting software. The Bookkeeper will be responsible for managing day-to-day financial transactions, preparing financial reports, and supporting the overall financial health of the organization.

* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting regulations, including governmental and non-profit accounting standards.
* Utilize accounting software such as QuickBooks, Quicken, Sage, Xero, or other relevant platforms for efficient record keeping.
* Support payroll processing and maintain employee records related to compensation and benefits.
* Collaborate with auditors during financial audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting roles, with a strong understanding of financial principles.
* Proficiency in accounting software (QuickBooks) is required; experience with public accounting is a plus.
* Knowledge of GAAP standards and experience in corporate or non-profit accounting preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform account recon

headlined_rolled.title: Payroll Specialist
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Payroll Specialist**

We are a fast-paced, busy construction company. The multi-tasking and efficiency is a must.

Essential Job Functions:  
The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the maintenance and proper execution of Certified and hourly payroll. Our payroll specialist is required to

* Manage payroll functions including: timecard processing, benefits administration, and timekeeping.
* Perform timekeeping duties such as: Timekeeping accountability, Timekeeping reports, Timecard reconciliation, Timecard maintenance, Timekeeping audits and compliance.
* Assist with the preparation of monthly payroll reports.
* Ensure prevailing wage jobs are compliant with the Department of Industry Relations.
* Provide Certified Payroll Reports to DIR and General Contractors.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Payroll role.
* Knowledge in timekeeping, payroll functions, and Quickbooks required.
* Prevailing Wage time-keeping required.

Benefits:  
We offer comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, 401k retirement plan with matching contributions. We also provide paid holidays.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Physical Setting:

* Office

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* Payroll: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Summary**

As an Office Manager, you’ll keep daily operations organized and welcoming. You’ll coordinate administrative workflows, support staff and clients, and help the office run smoothly through clear communication and reliable follow-through. Your impact: By keeping records accurate and calls and requests moving to the right people, you help colleagues stay focused and clients receive responsive support.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage Daily office operations (phones, emails, scheduling, supplies, and general organization)
* Schedule crews, subcontractors, and vendors
* Communicate with customers about time lines, updates and next steps
* Maintain complete job files and insurance related paperwork
* Assist with billing, accounts receivable/collections, and job costing
* Enter and update jobs in our project management software
* Track deadlines, follow-ups, and open items so jobs keep moving
* Support project managers and technicians so the can focus on the field work
* Help improve office processes and keep things running smoothly

**Qualifications**

* Office experience, including office management, administrative experience (restoration, construction, or service industry preferred)
* Strong organizational skills, and multitasking skills- you stay calm when things get busy.
* Excellent communication skills with both customers and internal teams
* Comfortable with microsoft office, Apple Products, and learning industry software (Xactimate, Encircle, or similar experience is a plus)
* Detail oriented, dependable, and able to handle multiple priorities
* Comfortable in fast paced, sometimes high stress environment

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* Consistent follow up and accurate CRM records.

* Clear professional communication and reliable transportation for Tampa Bay appointments.

* Willingness to learn residential remodeling scope and work within an approved pricing process.

Remodeling, home improvement, or related in home sales experience is preferred. Strong experience selling another considered purchase may also be relevant. Our field process can be taught; ownership of follow up and the sales conversation is essential.

We are a construction management (CM) firm in New York City looking for a Bookkeeper & Office Manager who is more than administrative support. CFD serves public agencies, healthcare, and higher education clients. This role is ideal for someone who understands how a business runs, works directly with the owner and leadership team, and is confident managing numbers, processes, vendors, and technology.

Customer Service Representative (CSR) – Plumbing & HVAC

Location: West Dennis

Job Type: Full-Time

About the Role

DeWolfe Plumbing Heating & Cooling, a family owned and operated company since 1931, is seeking a motivated and personable Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our plumbing and HVAC team. The ideal candidate is friendly, outgoing, and professional, with excellent communication skills and the ability to build relationships with customers over the phone. In this role, you’ll handle inbound service calls, schedule appointments, and also take part in outbound calling to existing and potential customers to follow up on service needs, promotions, and maintenance opportunities.

· Maintain accurate customer records and job notes in the company system.

· Assist with administrative support for the service team when needed.

· Represent the company with warmth, integrity, and professionalism in every interaction.

Qualifications

Required:

· Excellent communication and customer service skills.

· Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

· Comfortable making outbound calls and following up with customers.

· Proficiency with computers and ability to learn scheduling/CRM systems.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator & Inside Sales
headlined_rolled.desc:
About Diamond

Founded in 1974, Diamond Concrete Sawing is one of the Midwest's most trusted concrete sawing and cutting companies. We are family owned, based in Grand Rapids with branches around the state, and our locating work runs under Diamond Locating Services. We saw, drill, and cut concrete on some of the most demanding projects in Michigan, including a lot of MDOT highway and public works, and we locate what is underneath before anyone digs.

We are a company of about 30 people. That means no layers to work through and no waiting a week on a decision. You will know everyone here by name, including the operators running the work you quote.

The Role

This is an estimating and quoting role first, and a sales role second. Every quote at Diamond runs through this seat, whether it came from our outside sales rep, our Director of Service, a bid board, or a contractor who called in cold. The number has to be right, and it has to go out the same day.

You own a job from the moment it is found until it is sold and handed to Service. The first phone call, the questions that define the scope, the quote, the follow-up, and the handoff to dispatch all sit with you. You are the first impression most customers get of us.

The phone rings all day and priorities move. This seat fields inbound calls and email requests, carries a large book of open quotes at a time, and one crew hitting something unexpected in the field can reshuffle your afternoon. If you want a predictable desk, this is not it.

What You Will Do

* Own inbound customer requests and respond the same day.
* Confirm scope, location, access, timing, and special requirements before you quote. Call the client back the same day for anything missing, and ask the questions that change the number.
* Prepare and send quotes for the whole team.
* Follow up on every open quote you own until it is won or lost, and review the losses to find out why.
* Seek out new work daily through bid platforms and other lead sources.

Founded in 1913, Dietzler and its affiliates have delivered complex infrastructure projects across the United States for public entities and large private clients, with a strong emphasis on bridge, dam, and water utility projects.

Description:

CMP is looking for a dependable, organized, and customer-focused Concrete Pump Dispatcher to join our team. Our dispatch department plays an important role in keeping daily operations running smoothly by coordinating customers, concrete pump operators, equipment, and job schedules.This is a fast-paced position where no two days are exactly alike. The right candidate will be comfortable managing multiple priorities, communicating with customers and operators, solving problems, and adjusting plans when things don't go as expected.

**Previous dispatch or construction industry experience is preferred, but we are willing to train the right person.** If you are a strong communicator who enjoys staying organized, working with people, and being part of a team, we encourage you to apply.

**What You'll Do**

**Scheduling and Dispatch**

* Schedule and dispatch concrete pumps and operators based on customer needs, equipment availability, job locations, and daily priorities.
* Review daily and upcoming schedules to ensure jobs are properly staffed and equipped.
* Monitor active jobs and adjust schedules for delays, cancellations, breakdowns, weather, and changing customer needs.
* Confirm scheduled jobs and communicate job details, arrival times, and special instructions to operators.
* Help coordinate next-day scheduling and equipment assignments.

**Customer Service and Communication**

As a Construction Estimator, you’ll turn project plans into clear, well-supported cost estimates for commercial construction. headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
***Engage Contracting*** is looking for an ***Construction Estimator*** to join our team!

This Estimator will be responsible for building project bid packages, contacting subcontractors, managing project files to prepare cost and labor estimates for bids/proposals. The ideal candidate will have 5-7 years of commercial estimating, strong interpersonal communication skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of construction management.

* Independently prepare estimates for assigned scopes and smaller projects.
* Review construction documents, bid requirements, and specifications for completeness and scope applicability.
* Develop detailed trade scopes and coordinate subcontractor outreach.
* Perform quantity takeoffs using digital and traditional methods.
* Solicit, receive, and level subcontractor and supplier proposals.
* Identify scope gaps, overlaps, design conflicts, and constructability concerns.
* Prepare bid recaps, clarifications, assumptions, and proposal qualifications.
* Participate in scope review meetings and estimate review meetings.
* Assist with conceptual budgeting and value engineering exercises.
* Develop pricing using historical data, market input, and subcontractor feedback.
* Support risk review and pricing strategy discussions with department leadership.
* Prepare and assemble bid submission documents accurately and on time.
* Assist with project handoff to operations, including scope review and estimate turnover.
* Maintain accurate cost history and estimating database information.
* Mentor Junior Estimators and Estimator I team members on assigned tasks.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
