headlined_rolled.title: Traveling Assistant Project Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the successful execution of electrical construction projects by assisting in planning, coordination, and day-to-day project management activities. This role works closely with Project Managers, field leadership, vendors, and internal teams to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with company standards. The APM plays a key role in managing documentation, tracking project performance, supporting procurement and financial processes, and facilitating communication across all phases of the project lifecycle.

**Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities**

**T**asks may include, but are not limited to the following:

* Assist the PM in managing day-to-day project operations and administrative tasks.

* Support the preparation, review, and tracking of RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project logs.

* Help organize weekly project schedules, manpower plans, material deliveries, and long-lead tracking.

* Attend project meetings (internal and external) and prepare meeting notes or action items.

* Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure timely distribution of updates to stakeholders.

* Conduct periodic site walks with the PM or Superintendent to observe progress and verify installation compliance.

* Assist with documenting field conditions, tracking percent of completion, and reporting potential delays.

* Coordinate with field leadership to ensure alignment on project goals, safety standards, and execution plans.

* Assist in monitoring labor hours, equipment usage, and material costs.

* Review purchase orders, delivery tickets, and subcontractor invoices for accuracy.

* Help prepare weekly project summaries and cost-to-complete updates for leadership.

* Support communication between clients, general contractors, engineers, and Enterprise Electrical teams.

* Maintain professionalism when interacting with external partners while representing Enterprise

headlined_rolled.title: Preconstruction Administrative Specialist
headlined_rolled.desc:
The Preconstruction Estimating Department Administrative Specialist provides administrative, document control, and bid coordination support to Enterprise Electrical’s Preconstruction and Estimating team. This role organizes project information, tracks pursuit deadlines and submission requirements, coordinates vendor and subcontractor communications, and prepares proposal materials so estimators can develop accurate bids using current and complete information. The position supports the process from receipt of a bid invitation through proposal submission, bid follow-up, and transfer of awarded-project records.

Working under the direction of the Preconstruction Director or Chief Estimator, this position manages multiple administrative assignments with attention to accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through. The Administrative Specialist anticipates missing information, communicates deadline risks, and adapts quickly as priorities change in a growing electrical construction business. Estimators retain responsibility for technical scope, quantities, labor assumptions, pricing decisions, and final estimate approval.

**Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities**

Tasks may include, but are not limited to the following:

* Maintain the bid calendar, recording due dates, pre-bid meetings, site visits, review milestones, and customer submission requirements.

* Create project folders and maintain consistent naming, file organization, permissions, and document version control.

* Download, organize, and distribute drawings, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and customer instructions to the appropriate team members.

* Track document revisions and notify estimators of new addenda, changed deadlines, or updated submission requirements.

* Prepare and distribute invitations to bid using scope information and recipient lists approved by estimators.

* Maintain vendor and subcontractor contact information, bid lists, quotation logs, and records of follow-up activity.

headlined_rolled.title: MEPFP Systems Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The MEPFP Systems Estimator will prepare estimates for MEPFP trades (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection), working with the estimating team, architects, and clients to ensure accuracy and budget alignment. They will work on projects at all phases of design across all sectors of the business.

**Responsibilities**

* Perform pre-bid plan review for MEPFP scopes across all project types.
* Complete itemized quantity take-off and price estimating for the Mechanical (M), Electrical (E), Plumbing (P), and Fire Protection (FP) trades.
* Work with Estimators on analysis of subcontractor bids and assembly of proposals.
* Attend project interviews and estimating review sessions/meetings with the Erland team, architects, engineers, and clients.
* Utilize historical data, construction knowledge, and industry benchmarks to develop estimates.
* Facilitate subcontractor buyout of project MEPFP systems.
* Pre-purchase long lead MEPFP equipment as necessary to protect project schedules.
* Lead and support Value Engineering efforts on MEPFP systems.
* Develop and maintain relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent years of relevant industry experience in lieu of a degree.
* 4 - 8 years of experience in commercial mechanical estimating. Experience in plumbing, fire protection, or electrical estimating is a plus. A willingness and eagerness to learn additional trades through professional training and certification is required
* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems (rooftop systems, hydronic systems, exhaust systems, etc.) expected. Understanding of other specialty systems (process piping, etc.) is a plus.
* Working knowledge of related computer programs (On-Screen Takeoff, Autodesk Takeoff, Excel).
* Must be physically able to navigate a job site, potentially with rough terrain.

**Customer Service Representative – Full-Time or Part-Time**

**Location:** Perham, MN **Compensation:** $17.50 – $18.00 per hour

**Schedule:** Part-time or Full-time  
**Part-Time:** M–F, 12:00 PM–5:00 PM **Full-Time:** M–F, 8:30/9:00 AM–5:00 PM

**Looking for a Great Place to Start?**

Esser Plumbing & Heating is looking for a friendly, dependable person to join our Perham office as a Customer Service Representative. This is a great entry-level opportunity for someone who enjoys talking with people and is comfortable using a computer. You’ll be part of the team that answers our phones and connects customers with the right person or service.

**What You’ll Do**

* Answer incoming phone calls and greet customers in a friendly, helpful way
* Help customers with basic questions and direct calls to the right person or department
* Assist with scheduling and confirming service appointments
* Enter customer information into our computer system
* Help with basic emails and customer follow-up
* Provide general office support as needed
* Learn more about our company and services as you go

Previous customer service experience is not required for this position. We’re looking for someone who:

* Is friendly and enjoys helping people
* Answers the phone with a smile on their face
* Is dependable and comes to work on time
* Communicates clearly and professionally
* Maintains calm under pressure
* Is comfortable using computers and learning new software systems
* Pays close attention to details
* Is willing to ask questions and learn
* Works well as part of a team

  

**Why Work at Esser?**

Esser Plumbing & Heating is a locally owned and well-respected company. You’ll work with an experienced team in a stable business where you can learn new skills and grow over time. We will provide the training you need to succeed!

  

Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including health and dental insurance, paid time off, paid holidays, and more.

Job Title: Door-to-Door Sales Representative – Appointment Setter (Roofing)

Company: Flightline Restoration LLC  
Location: Louisville, KY  
Job Type: [Full-time / Part-time]  
Pay: Commission/bonus per confirmed appointment

About Us  
Flightline Restoration LLC is a growing roofing and exterior restoration company serving the Louisville area. We specialize in roof inspections, roof repair and replacement, siding, and gutters. We are known for honest assessments, quality work, and treating every customer's home like our own. We are looking for energetic Door-to-Door Appointment Setters to represent us in neighborhoods across the city.

Job Summary  
You are the face of our company in the neighborhood. You go door to door in assigned areas, introduce Flightline Restoration, offer homeowners a free roof inspection, and set the appointment. That's it.

Your ONLY job is to set and confirm appointments.

What You Will NOT Do

* ❌ You will NOT close sales — you never discuss prices, contracts, or payments
* ❌ You will NOT inspect roofs — you never climb on a roof or evaluate its condition
* ❌ You will NOT deal with customers beyond the door — no handling jobs, complaints, scheduling changes, or follow-up service

Once you've set and confirmed the appointment, your part is done. Our inspection and sales team takes it from there.

Responsibilities

* Knock doors in assigned neighborhoods and introduce our company professionally
* Offer and promote our free roof inspection service
* Strike up conversations with homeowners about their roof's age, condition, leaks, and storm damage
* Set qualified inspection appointments and collect accurate contact information
* Confirm your appointments by phone or text before the scheduled time so homeowners are ready
* Mark and record every door, conversation, and appointment in our tracking system/app
* Work targeted areas, including neighborhoods affected by recent storms

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator
Sewer Sales Project Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**GENZ RYAN IS HIRING!**

**Sewer Sales Rep & Project Owner: Sell It. Run It. Finish It.**

Most sewer sales jobs end at the signature. Yours starts there.

At Genz-Ryan, you're the homeowner's go-to from the first camera drop to the final restoration. You find the problem, show them the footage, present honest options, close the deal, and then own the project all the way to the finish line. One rep, one point of contact, zero handoff headaches.

**Our culture**

We're hungry, humble, and smart. We give straight feedback, laugh a lot, and live by our core values: Pride, Drive, Team Player, Respect, and Get Sh!t Done. Honesty is how we sell.

**What you'll do**

* **Diagnose.** Run in-home consultations, camera inspections, and line locates to find roots, bellies, offsets, cracks, and collapses in clay, cast iron, and Orangeburg pipe.
* **Prove it.** Every recommendation is backed by video. No footage, no sale.
* **Sell it.** Present good/better/best options, from cleaning and root treatment to spot repair, open-trench, pipe bursting, and CIPP lining. Offer financing on $8K–$30K+ projects.
* **Run it.** Build airtight proposals, then manage the job from start to finish. That means permits, Gopher State One Call locates, crew scheduling, I/I and point-of-sale requirements, and keeping the homeowner in the loop at every step.
* **Finish it.** Make sure restoration is done right and the customer is thrilled enough to leave a review.

  
**Requirements**  

* **2+ years of in-home sales experience in sewer, plumbing, HVAC, or home services required**
* **Must have a valid driver's license**
* Close high-ticket work by building trust, not pressure
* Love keeping a dozen moving pieces organized and on schedule
* Can explain underground problems in plain English
* Don't mind crawl spaces, basements, Minnesota winters, or a little sewage (PPE provided)
* Have a valid driver's license and are comfortable with tablets and field software
* Bonus: trenchless experience or a plum

**About the Company**

For 20+ years, Georgia Development Partners has delivered premier heavy civil and site development work across metro Atlanta. As a 100% employee-owned company, our team members share directly in our success while building high-quality projects with lasting community impact.

We are seeking a highly skilled Estimator to lead site development bids from plan review through final submission. **Quantify the Projects, Solve Our Customers Problems, and Support the Backlog Leading to Company Success**

**About Gillett Excavating**

In just ten years, we’ve grown from a small residential startup into a company trusted to build the infrastructure that millions of people rely on every day, most of it buried underground, unseen but essential. Gillett has developed into a full service heavy civil and mass earthwork company that takes pride in putting infrastructure in the ground, moving mass amounts of dirt quickly, and building our customers dreams from the ground up. Our core values are centered around our team and how we provide for each other and our clients. After years of structuring and building a stable footing in the industry, we are doubling down on our best investment yet, people. We believe hard work should lead to real rewards, accountability should create opportunity, and every project is a chance to raise the standard for what this industry can be.

**How You’ll Contribute**

You will serve as the engine for our preconstruction phase, handling plan reviews, takeoffs, and submittal tracking from start to finish. By absorbing our estimating backlog and administrative workflows, you will enable us to bid more work with greater accuracy and consistency.

* **Own the Takeoff Process:** Drive our preconstruction pipeline by generating precise mass earthwork, utility, and paving quantities using InSite, PlanSwift, and Bluebeam.

* **Scrutinize Plans & Specs:** Perform thorough plan and spec reviews to catch utility conflicts, design discrepancies, and constructability issues before they hit the field.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Assistant Project Manager to support our team in building Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs). This role involves assisting with project planning, coordination, and execution to ensure timely and quality delivery of construction projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in construction management, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist in coordinating all phases of ADU construction projects from inception to completion.
* Support project managers in developing project schedules, budgets, and resource plans.

* Communicate regularly with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to facilitate smooth project flow.
* Track project progress, document issues or delays, and assist in resolving any challenges that arise during construction.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, reports, and records for internal use and client updates.
* Support procurement processes by sourcing materials and coordinating deliveries as needed.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies throughout all project phases.

* Prior experience or strong interest in construction management or related fields; experience building ADUs is a plus.

* Strong communication skills for effective collaboration with team members and clients.
* Ability to interpret construction plans, specifications, and schedules.
* Proficiency in basic computer applications such as MS Office Suite; familiarity with project management software is advantageous.

**Who We Are**

Glass Roots Construction (GRC) is a first-class fiber optic utility construction firm founded by career telecom and construction professionals. We leverage the latest technologies and up-to-date construction practices to design and build high-performance networks that deliver fast, reliable connectivity for businesses, schools, and healthcare.

At GRC, we believe that great infrastructure is built on two foundational commitments:

* **Safety First:** This is our #1 priority and a mutual commitment. We protect our team members, the public, and our customers' assets by prioritizing safety over production and ensuring every project is executed without shortcuts so everyone goes home safe.
* **Quality & Excellence:** We commit to excellence in every detail. By investing in our people, best-in-industry equipment, and processes, we deliver reliable, lasting work and exceptional, professional service for our customers.

We are looking for people who take pride in their trade and want to help us lay the foundation for a safer, more connected future.

**The Opportunity**

Glass Roots Construction (GRC) is seeking a strategic and results-driven VP of Procurement to own and scale our national supply chain and procurement operations. As we rapidly expand our fiber optic utility construction footprint, this role is critical to optimizing our cost structure and driving our bottom line. This role is for a seasoned executive who has built procurement functions from the ground up and is ready to lead the next phase: transforming spend consolidation, executing high-stakes negotiations, and ensuring a resilient supply chain. Working directly with executive leadership, you will set the operating standards, design the systems, and build the team that executes our procurement strategy accurately, efficiently, and at scale.

**Do you believe the best customer service is getting someone help today, not next week?**

**Ready to lead a phone team inside a 27-year, family-owned company that plays to win the day, every day?**

Home services experience is a plus, but not required. If you've led a team that books or outbounds over the phone, and your people would tell you that you made them better than they were the day before, keep reading.

**The Opportunity:**  
Our Customer Service team is the first voice every customer hears. They answer calls for our Des Moines, Omaha, and Utah markets from one room in Iowa, and they turn those conversations into the appointments our technicians run every day.

At Golden Rule, we win the day through our three-day call board. When the board is full, customers get help fast, and our technicians stay busy. This role is the coach who makes that happen.

The role has grown since we last hired for it. AI tools now handle part of our call volume, which frees this leader to focus on what matters most: coaching people, filling the board, and protecting a five-star experience on every call.

**What You'll Own:**

* Leadership of a team of 5–10 Customer Service Representatives handling calls for three markets

headlined_rolled.title: Bookkeeper/Administrative Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Position Summary:**

Gornall Construction, Inc. is seeking a dependable and organized **Receptionist/bookkeeper / Office Assistant** to support daily operations in our front office. This individual will be the first point of contact for clients and vendors, and will provide administrative support across multiple areas of the business, including scheduling, bookkeeping, and document management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Answer and direct incoming phone calls** in a professional and courteous manner
* **Greet and assist visitors** at the front desk
* **Scan, upload, and file receipts**, invoices, and other documents into digital systems
* **Schedule appointments and job site visits** for office staff and field supervisors
* **Send and receive invoices and payments** **using QuickBooks** or similar accounting software
* **Support the office team** with clerical tasks, data entry, and communication
* **Manage incoming and outgoing mail**, email, and deliveries
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems
* Assist with supply orders, printing, and occasional errands

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED
* 2 years of quickbooks experience
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Comfortable learning basic accounting or invoicing software (QuickBooks )
* Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
* Professional appearance and phone etiquette

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive hourly wage based on experience
* Paid holidays after 6 months
* One week vacation after 1 year, two weeks after 3 years
* 401k match after 1 year
* Friendly and professional office environment

Pay: $17.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Experience:

* QuickBooks: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.desc:
Gothic Landscape is the largest family-owned and operated landscaping company, and a leading commercial landscape construction and maintenance company committed to creating inspiring commercial landscapes. We are known for our exceptional service and dedication to customer satisfaction.

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Assistant Account Executive to join our Phoenix construction branch. The ideal candidate will have a passion for landscape construction, exceptional communication skills, and customer service skills. As an Assistant Account Executive, you will play a crucial role in driving business growth and ensuring client satisfaction.

**Highlights of what our Assistant Account Executive will do:**

* Assist Account Executive with project demands by initiating bid and design process as well as supporting thereafter.
* Review and prepare documents that assist in the sales process.
* Deliver and provide samples or product data necessary to secure projects.
* Attend client functions and meetings with or in lieu of Account Executive.
* Assist Account Executives with calendar and task management.
* Act as liaison between internal departments and Account Executive on miscellaneous tasks, initiates, and improvements.
* Assist with evaluating sales trends and determining market strategies and goals for product and services offered.
* Research clients, industry trends and process improvements as needed.

**Are you the right fit for this role? Skills & experience that an ideal Account Executive would possess are:**

* Minimum 1-year of relationship based sales/customer service experience (**construction or related industries) is preferred.**
* Minimum 2-year of project management experience (construction or related industries) is preferred.
* Excellent people and relationship building skills, creative problem-solving capability, and excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Flexible work hours with the ability to attend events beyond normal business hours.

headlined_rolled.title: Office Assistant for Construction Company
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Overview**  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Office Assistant to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of our office environment. This position requires strong organizational skills, proficiency in various software applications, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. If you are a motivated individual with excellent phone etiquette and administrative skills, we would love to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**  
- Answer and direct phone calls with professionalism and courtesy.  
- Manage front desk operations, greeting visitors and ensuring a welcoming atmosphere.  
- Perform data entry tasks accurately and efficiently, maintaining up-to-date records.

- Organize and maintain office files, both physical and electronic.

- Bilingual  
- Strong phone etiquette with excellent verbal communication skills.  
- Proficiency in QuickBooks is a plus but not mandatory.  
- Familiarity with front desk operations and customer service principles.  
- Competence in data entry with attention to detail and accuracy.  
- Proficient in using Excel, PDF, and Google Sheets, for document creation and management.  
- Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.  
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.  
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn new skills related to office management.

If you are ready to contribute to a dynamic team while enhancing your administrative skills, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity!

**Accounting Specialist (AP/AR)**

HWA Construction is seeking a detail-oriented Accounting Specialist to manage accounts payable and accounts receivable for our high-end custom residential projects. This role keeps project finances accurate and up to date. You’ll process subcontractor and vendor invoices, bill clients, track lien waivers and insurance compliance, and reconcile accounts so our Project Managers and leadership can rely on clear, current job cost information.

The Accounting Specialist works closely with Project Managers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients. The ideal candidate is organized, accurate, and responsive. They take ownership of the details and bring the same hospitality-driven professionalism to financial communication that HWA brings to every client relationship.

**The Company**  
HWA Construction is a Los Angeles-based builder of custom luxury homes. We are hospitality-driven, commercially disciplined, and residentially focused. We collaborate with some of Los Angeles’ most respected architects and designers to deliver exceptional homes through a commitment to service, transparency, and quality. Our clients value the experience as much as the finished product, and we believe that delivering an outstanding client experience starts with a well-organized, thoughtful, and transparent process from the very beginning.

At HWA, we value our team and believe that a strong company culture, clear communication, and individual accountability are essential to delivering exceptional results for our clients.

headlined_rolled.title: Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Office Manager – Horizon Excavation**

**Branson, MO | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.**

Horizon Excavation is looking for an experienced **Office Manager** to oversee the administrative and financial needs of our excavation and site work business. This position handles payroll, AP/AR, invoicing, job costing, lien waivers, and general office operations while supporting our project managers and field crews.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process weekly payroll and code labor to jobs/cost codes.
* Manage accounts payable, vendor invoices, W-9s, and 1099 documentation.
* Prepare customer invoices, progress billings, and AIA pay applications.
* Track receivables, retainage, change orders, and past-due accounts.
* Prepare and track lien waivers for customers, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Maintain job files, contracts, permits, insurance certificates, and DOT/vehicle records.
* Support project managers with job setup, bids, submittals, and paperwork.
* Assist with employee onboarding and personnel records.

Every data center Hut 8 builds depends on a particular list of materials that are expensive, commodity driven, and critical to get on time. This Sourcing Manager owns those categories.

The Sourcing Manager works cross-functionally with Engineering, Construction, Finance/AP, Legal, and Operations to protect project schedules and minimize material supply risk across capital projects.

* Own sourcing strategies for specialty construction materials including MV and LV cables, conduit, grounding systems, fiber, , and electrical distribution equipment across the full site supply chain.

* Report category spend, savings, and supply risk, and recommend improvements that reduce risk and improve cash flow timing

**ABOUT YOU**

* Demonstrated experience negotiating supply agreements with manufacturers and distributors, including metal price adjustment terms

* Comfortable reading single line diagrams, cable schedules, and e

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Sourcing Manager, Principal
headlined_rolled.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Skilled trade labor is one of the hardest things to secure on a data center build. This Sourcing Manager owns how Hut 8 finds, qualifies, and contracts the subcontractors that do the work in the field, such as mechanical, electrical, and civil subcontractors, so trade providers show up per the schedule needs, deliver the contracted scope at optimal cost.

The Sourcing Manager works cross-functionally with Construction, Engineering, Finance/AP, Legal, and Operations to lock in subtrade capacity early and minimize commercial and execution risk across capital projects.

Some of the responsibilities you can expect include the following:

* Build a subtrade sourcing plan for each site, including package strategy, target bidders, and a buyout schedule tied to the construction schedule

* Map and prequalify subtrade partners in each market on capacity , safety record (EMR, TRIR, OSHA history), bonding, financial health, manpower, and project history

* Write scope sheets, run competitive bids, and level bids to close scope gaps before award

* Negotiate subcontracts, labor and unit rates, escalation, and manpower commitments, and put program agreements in place with proven partners

* Track trade capacity and competing projects, identifying early risk indicators and escalating before they affect the schedule

* Review change orders, T&M tickets, and claims for merit and price, and keep payments aligned with contractual milestones

* Score subtrade partners after each project and recommend improvements that reduce risk and improve cash flow timing

**ABOUT YOU**

* Bachelor's degree in construction management, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field preferred (equivalent experience considered)

* 5+ years of experience in subcontract buyout, procurement, or contracts management on large capital projects

* Demonstrated experience leveling trade bids and negotiating subcontracts across multiple trade scopes

* Able to read drawings and specifications

**Overview**

**Overview**

As a Construction Estimator, you’ll turn project plans into clear, well-supported cost estimates. Interlaken, Inc., a progressive, family-oriented, fast-growing heavy civil contractor is searching for an assistant project manager to join our team. headlined_rolled.title: Construction Project Administrator/Operations Coordinator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**About Us**

Invicta Construction Solutions, Inc. is a growing nationwide general contractor specializing in healthcare and medical facilities, commercial automotive, and retail construction. We manage ground-up construction, tenant improvements, and renovations across the United States.

We are looking for an **experienced, highly organized Construction Project Administrator / Operations Coordinator** who can take ownership of daily project administration, support our field teams, and help keep multiple construction projects running efficiently.

**This is a hands-on position for someone who understands commercial construction, takes initiative, and doesn't need to be constantly reminded to get things done.**

**What You'll Do**

* Manage project documentation, subcontract agreements, submittals, RFIs, and project logs.
* Track subcontractor insurance certificates, W-9s, licenses, and contract compliance.
* Coordinate permitting, contractor licensing, business registrations, and renewals across multiple states.
* Support Project Managers and Superintendents with daily administrative and operational needs.
* Arrange superintendent travel, temporary housing, jobsite supplies, and project mobilization services.
* Obtain competitive vendor pricing for dumpsters, portable restrooms, construction trailers, and other project needs.
* Track material procurement, long-lead items, and outstanding project documentation.
* Coordinate utility accounts, builders risk insurance, and project-related administrative requirements.
* Manage project closeout documentation, including warranties, O&M manuals, as-builts, lien waivers, and punch lists.
* Coordinate subcontractor warranty work and follow up until outstanding issues are resolved.
* Assist executive leadership with office operations, scheduling, document management, and internal coordination.

**What We're Looking For**

* **3+ years of commercial construction administration or project coordination experience preferred.**

headlined_rolled.title: AP Specialist / Accounting Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
At J.J. Barney Construction, we look for people who work hard and have fun doing so. We move quickly, but never compromise on what matters most—our core values of Safety, Coachability, Collaboration, and Accountability.

**Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **AP Specialist / Accounting Assistant** to manage all aspects of the accounts payable workflow as well as providing support to the finance department.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working in a deadline-driven environment. This position plays a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting overall accounting operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Process vendor invoices through the accounts-payable workflow, including securing approvals, verifying and maintaining documentation, and ensuring timely payment.
* Manage credit card workflow, matching transactions with bank feeds, collaborating with credit card users to ensure receipts are uploaded.
* Reconcile credit card, bank and vendor statements; obtain supporting documentation as needed.
* Respond professionally to vendor inquiries while maintaining positive working relationships.
* Prepare and distribute job cost reports for Project Managers.
* Create intercompany invoices.
* Provide backup support for payroll processing.
* Request and track certificates of insurance for new equipment and vehicles.
* Maintain and update equipment documentation records.
* Provide general administrative support to the finance department.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* High school diploma or GED required, associate degree in accounting or related field preferred.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in accounts payable and accounting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel experience preferred) and accounting software.
* Strong numerical aptitude with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proactive and assertive, able to handle vendor calls directly and professionally.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Office Administrator
headlined_rolled.company: JBH Custom Homes and Remodeling LLC
headlined_rolled.desc:
JBH Custom Homes & Remodeling is hiring an organized, dependable Construction Office Administrator to support our owners and help keep daily operations running smoothly. We handle custom homes, additions, and remodeling projects.

This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys organizing paperwork, coordinating schedules, communicating with people, and following tasks through to completion. You will work closely with the owners, project manager, field crews, subcontractors, suppliers, and customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Answer phone calls and emails and assist with customer communication.
* Help coordinate project schedules, appointments, inspections, and deliveries.
* Prepare permit paperwork, submit applications, and follow up with building departments.
* Assist with employee onboarding, time tracking, and payroll preparation.
* Request supplier pricing, place approved material orders, and track deliveries.
* Organize invoices, receipts, purchase orders, proposals, and change orders.
* Assist with entering and organizing information in Houzz Pro and QuickBooks.
* Maintain current project files, including plans, permits, selections, and subcontractor documents.
* Track outstanding tasks and keep the owners informed of deadlines and items needing attention.

We are looking for someone with:

* Previous office administration experience; construction experience is preferred.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and professional communication skills.
* The ability to prioritize tasks and follow through with minimal reminders.
* Confidence using email, spreadsheets, calendars, and digital filing systems.
* Discretion when handling customer, employee, and financial information.
* A willingness to learn our systems and construction processes.

Experience with **Houzz Pro, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, permitting, payroll, or purchasing** is a plus. Familiarity with local building department procedures is especially helpful.

* Coordinate with field and office teams to help resolve scheduling conflicts, documentation issues, and communication gaps.
* Identify changing priorities and make sure the right people are informed.

The Construction Office Manager coordinates essential administrative and financial processes that support construction operations. This role combines accounting and finance experience with customer service, confidential information handling, and organized office administration. You’ll help keep employee records, payroll, accounts, leave, and fleet information accurate and accessible to the appropriate people.

* Maintain spreadsheets and accounting information using Microsoft Office.
* Coordinate fleet management records and administrative follow-up.
* Respond to customer inquiries with professional, helpful service.
* Handle confidential information carefully and appropriately.

* Accounting and finance experience.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Purchasing Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Purchasing Assistant to join our dynamic procurement team. In this vital role, you will support the sourcing, purchasing, and inventory management processes to ensure seamless supply chain operations. Your expertise will help optimize vendor relationships, manage procurement systems, and contribute to cost-effective purchasing strategies. This position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your skills in materials management and supply chain management within a fast-paced, collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is energetic, highly organized, and passionate about driving efficiency through effective purchasing practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist in managing procurement activities using system platforms to process purchase orders and track procurement workflows.
* Support vendor communication efforts by coordinating order placements, follow-ups, and resolving discrepancies to maintain strong vendor relationships.
* Maintain accurate inventory records through inventory management systems and spreadsheets, ensuring optimal stock levels and timely replenishments.
* Collaborate with logistics teams to coordinate delivery schedules, monitor shipping statuses, and optimize supply chain flow.
* Analyze Excel data for procurement trends, pricing analysis, and reporting purposes to support strategic sourcing decisions.
* Contribute to contract management by reviewing supplier agreements and assisting in sourcing negotiations for cost savings and quality improvements.
* Support the implementation of purchasing management systems (including SAP ERP, Oracle EBS) to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.

**Skills**

* Strong understanding of materials management, inventory control, and supply chain management principles.
* Experience with purchasing management systems that are technically supported within an organization’s infrastructure.
* Excellent vendor communication skills

* **Blueprint Reading:** Strong capability to read architectural blueprints, structural drawings, and technical specifications.
* **Market Knowledge:** Familiarity with pricing of residential construction trades and material suppliers.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for presenting proposals to clients, negotiating with subcontractors and working with project managers and crews.

JKM Electric is an established electrical contractor serving federal and commercial clients throughout the Washington, DC metropolitan area. Founded in 1997, we specialize in electrical construction, renovations, and service work in complex, occupied facilities, including healthcare, laboratories, and government buildings.

We are a growing, family-owned company looking for an experienced construction bookkeeper to support our day-to-day accounting operations.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, experienced bookkeeper who understands construction accounting and can independently manage routine accounting responsibilities with accuracy and consistency.

This is a hands-on position focused primarily on accounts payable, transaction processing, account reconciliations, and maintaining accurate financial records.

The ideal candidate has worked in a construction environment, understands job costing, comminicates proactively, and can manage assigned responsibilities without extensive oversight.

This position is initially part-time, approximately 20 hours per week.

* Record and categorize daily financial transactions, including credit card purchases, employee reimbursements, and other operating expenses.
* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and general ledger accounts; identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate job-cost records by ensuring labor, materials, subcontractor expenses, and other costs are properly assigned.
* Support monthly accounting close by completing reconciliations, reviewing account balances, and resolving outstanding transactions.
* Maintain organized accounting

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**About JLV Construction**

JLV Construction specializes in high-end residential construction, custom homes, major renovations, additions, and historic restoration, with additional commercial construction projects. We take pride in delivering quality work, maintaining high standards, and providing our clients with an excellent construction experience.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive Construction Estimator who understands that accurate estimating requires more than measuring drawings and entering prices. The right candidate will take the time to understand each project, identify missing scope, verify critical information, and prepare estimates that our team can confidently use to price, plan, and execute construction work.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary:** $60,000–$75,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
* **Performance Bonus:** Eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 10% of total annual base salary, based on individual performance and applicable bonus criteria.
* **Gas Allowance:** $70 paid biweekly.
* **Vehicle Allowance:** $200 per month.
* **Cellphone Allowance:** $50 per month.
* **Health Insurance:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance fully paid by JLV.
* **Paid Time Off:** Paid vacation and PTO.
* **Professional Development:** Paid training, ongoing learning, and opportunities for career advancement.

**What You'll Do**

**Project Review & Estimating**

* Review architectural drawings, specifications, project descriptions, and available site information to understand project requirements.
* Perform material takeoffs and prepare accurate, well-documented construction estimates.
* Identify missing information, conflicting details, incomplete scope, and potential cost risks.
* Apply current pricing, subcontractor quotes, historical project data, and established estimating methods appropriately.

headlined_rolled.title: Asphalt Estimator/Sales
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Now Hiring: Asphalt Estimator / Sales Representative**  
**Lucas Paving | Residential & Commercial Paving**

Lucas Paving is seeking an Asphalt Estimator / Sales Representative to help grow our residential and commercial paving business. We’re looking for someone who can build strong customer relationships, evaluate project needs, and prepare accurate, competitive proposals.

**Responsibilities**

* Meet with homeowners, property managers, business owners, and general contractors to discuss paving needs.
* Visit project sites, take measurements, and evaluate existing conditions.
* Prepare estimates for labor, materials, equipment, trucking, and subcontracted work.
* Develop clear proposals that accurately describe the scope of work.
* Follow up on bids, answer customer questions, and close sales.
* Coordinate with our operations team to communicate project details and customer expectations.
* Maintain organized records of leads, estimates, and customer communications.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in asphalt paving estimating or construction sales preferred.
* Knowledge of asphalt paving, grading, base preparation, and pavement maintenance.
* Strong communication, customer service, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to read plans, take accurate measurements, and calculate material quantities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple bids and follow-up deadlines.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Additional commission based on sales.
* Health insurance provided.
* Company truck provided.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94601

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Payroll Specialist
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Construction Payroll Specialist – Union & Multi-State Payroll**

**Position Summary**

The Construction Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for a construction workforce operating across multiple states and union jurisdictions throughout the United States. This position requires extensive involvement with union payroll, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), prevailing wage requirements, certified payroll, multi-state taxation, employee deductions, fringe benefits, and job-cost allocation.

The Payroll Specialist works closely with field personnel, project management, accounting, human resources, union representatives, and benefit funds to ensure employees are paid accurately and all payroll-related reporting and compliance requirements are satisfied.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Payroll Processing**

* Process weekly payroll for union and non-union employees across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* Review employee timecards for accuracy, approvals, job numbers, cost codes, work classifications, and applicable pay rates.
* Calculate regular wages, overtime, double time, shift premiums, travel-related compensation, and other applicable earnings.
* Maintain accurate employee payroll records, tax elections, direct deposits, deductions, and other payroll information.
* Research and resolve payroll discrepancies in coordination with employees, supervisors, project managers, and accounting personnel.
* Process payroll adjustments, corrections, voids, and off-cycle payments when necessary.

**Union Payroll & Fringe Benefits**

* Interpret and apply multiple collective bargaining agreements and union wage schedules.
* Maintain union, local, trade, classification, and jurisdiction-specific wage and fringe benefit rates.
* Calculate employer-paid and employee-paid union benefits, which may include health and welfare, pension, annuity, training, vacation, apprenticeship, and other required funds.

Construction Project Coordinator – Residential Remodeling

**Company:** Kitchen by Design Inc.  
**Location:** Pasadena, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site and Local Project Visits  
**Compensation:** $50,000–$60,000 annually, depending on experience  
**Experience:** 2–3 years preferred

About Kitchen by Design

Kitchen by Design is a family-owned general contracting and residential remodeling company based in Pasadena, California. We specialize in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinetry, countertops, flooring, custom closets, and interior renovations.

As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Construction Project Coordinator to help manage our projects, support daily operations, and contribute to the continued growth of our business.

Position Overview

The Construction Project Coordinator will work closely with company ownership, subcontractors, vendors, and homeowners to ensure remodeling projects are properly scheduled, organized, and completed efficiently.

This is a hands-on position that combines project coordination, field visits, material procurement, customer communication, and operational support.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is interested in developing a long-term career in residential construction and project management.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Coordination & Scheduling**

* Coordinate daily and weekly schedules for active remodeling projects.
* Communicate with subcontractors, installers, suppliers, and homeowners regarding upcoming work.
* Track project timelines, milestones, and outstanding tasks.
* Coordinate material deliveries and installation schedules.
* Identify scheduling conflicts and communicate potential delays.
* Assist management with maintaining organized and efficient project workflows.

**Customer Communication**

* Provide homeowners with regular project updates.

headlined_rolled.title: Accounting Clerk
headlined_rolled.desc:
Description:

Serving Arkansas with excellence for over 50 years, Klaasmeyer Construction Company is looking for an Accounting Clerk to join our Finance team in Conway, Arkansas. In this position, you will report directly to the Controller and work closely with senior accounting staff to keep the company's financial records accurate, organized, and audit-ready. You'll handle invoice processing, vendor management, purchase order verification, and credit card processing. If you're detail-driven, trustworthy with sensitive information, and ready to grow in accounting, we want to hear from you.

Requirements:

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Inputting invoices, receipts, and payments into the accounting system with a high degree of accuracy
* Setting up new vendor profiles and making sure required tax documentation, including Form W-9, is on file before any payments are processed
* Verifying that purchase orders match invoices in the accounting software — confirming quantities, unit prices, and totals before approving for payment
* Reviewing monthly vendor statements to confirm every listed invoice has been received and processed, and resolving any discrepancies
* Reaching out to vendors to resolve billing discrepancies, missing documentation, and statement reconciliation issues
* Printing checks for review by the Controller or an authorized signatory, with all supporting backup documentation attached
* Processing company credit card transactions — coding charges to the correct accounts, collecting receipts, and reconciling card activity
* Scanning, organizing, and digitizing financial documents in a well-organized, audit-ready electronic filing system
* Helping with outgoing mail and basic banking tasks as directed
* Assisting the accounting team with special projects and basic reconciliations

**What We Need From You**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required
* Basic understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) required

The Estimator supports the pre-construction process by developing accurate takeoffs, budgets, scopes, and pricing for all assigned projects. This role contributes directly to project strategy, competitiveness, and risk management by producing clear, organized, and well-documented estimates. The Estimator works closely with Senior Pre-Construction staff, Business Development, and Project Management to ensure early project information is dependable and aligned with client expectations.

***Conceptual Drawings / Drafting***

* Develops conceptual layouts, drawings, and early design documents as needed for budgets or proposals.

* Prepares graphics, exhibits, and conceptual plans that support project understanding.

* Ensures conceptual drawings accurately reflect project intent under direction of senior staff.

***Bid Interest Generation***

* Supports outreach to subcontractors and vendors to gather bid interest.

* Ensures subcontractors receive accurate bid information, drawings, and schedules.

* Maintains consistent communication to ensure adequate bid coverage.

***Takeoff***

* Completes accurate quantity takeoffs using company-approved tools and methods.

* Documents assumptions and clarifications for estimating transparency.

* Reviews drawings thoroughly to ensure all scope is captured.

* Develops budgets and detailed scopes of work that reflect project requirements.

* Ensures inclusions, exclusions, and assumptions are clearly communicated.

* Prepares detailed cost breakdowns and pricing summaries for internal review.

* Prepares handoff materials for Project Management and Operations after project award.

* Communicates key cost drivers, scope considerations, and estimating assumptions.

* Supports PMs during early execution planning to ensure smooth transition.

* Estimate accuracy compared to final project costs

headlined_rolled.title: Payroll Specialist/Controller Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Role Summary**

The Payroll Specialist / Controller Assistant is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for the organization, including reviewing timesheets, processing payroll, managing payroll tax requirements, and maintaining employee payroll records. This role also supports the accounting function by handling accounts payable and accounts receivable activities, such as processing and organizing vendor invoices, assisting with new vendor setup, preparing and distributing customer invoices, and supporting collection efforts to ensure timely receipt of payments.

**Core Responsibilities**

***Timesheet Review***

* Reviews employee timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and proper approval.

* Verifies hours worked, overtime, PTO, and applicable job or cost codes.

* Identifies and resolves timesheet discrepancies while ensuring payroll deadlines are met.

Payroll Processing & Compliance

* Processes payroll accurately and on schedule for hourly and salaried employees.

* Assists with payroll reporting and reconciliation activities while ensuring compliance with applicable payroll regulations.

* Process payroll tax and garnishments each week.

***Employee Payroll Records***

* Maintains accurate, complete, and confidential employee payroll records.

* Updates records for new hires, terminations, pay changes, and deductions.

* Responds to employee questions and ensures payroll documentation is properly retained.

***Accounts Payable***

* Manage and organize the Accounts Payable email inbox.

* Manage new vendor and subcontractor setup, ensuring all required documents are received.

* Enters and processes credit card transactions and vendor invoices in Spectrum.

***Accounts Receivable***

* Distribute monthly billing and communicate with customers regarding payment status.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up to ensure timely payment.

* Assist with collection efforts and customer account inquiries as needed.

The Estimator at Kustom plays a critical role in developing accurate, complete, and defensible estimates for restoration projects. This position is responsible for reviewing loss information, evaluating property damage, preparing estimates primarily in Xactimate, supporting estimate approvals, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure scopes are clear, profitable, and aligned with Kustom standards.

  

The Estimator partners closely with operations, production, project leadership, adjusters, carriers, and customers to support timely project progression from initial assessment through approval and handoff. * Ensure estimates include accurate quantities, line items, supporting documentation, photos, notes, and applicable assumptions.

* Develop initial project schedules and coordinate timelines with customers, Superintendents and Division Managers.
* Create awarded jobs in the operating software, verify quantities and documentation, and complete project handoff to the Superintendent.
* Coordinate internal preconstruction meetings and owner/engineer meetings as required.
* Coordinate with Administration to establish required subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Maintain current plans, specifications, bid files and project documentation in appropriate systems and SharePoint

Not a franchise. Not private equity-backed. MSP is a family business approaching 4th generation ownership - that kind of continuity says everything about how we operate. Your feedback reaches the people who make decisions, and you’ll know your leaders by name.

-------------------------

Dispatch is a people job as much as a scheduling job. You are talking to customers having a bad day and technicians having a long one, often at the same time.

* Dispatch, scheduling or high-volume customer service experience
* ServiceTitan experience strongly preferred
* Calm under pressure - a full board and a ringing phone do not rattle you

* Assist in administration of purchase orders and help maintain complete project financial records.
* Assist with customer billing, including progress/draw invoices, change order billing, and tracking receivables.

**Company:** Monte Cabinets LLC  
**Location:** Las Vegas, Nevada  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Person  
**Pay:** $19.00–$21.00 per hour + Project Commissions  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

About Monte Cabinets

Monte Cabinets is a Las Vegas-based custom cabinetry and architectural millwork company specializing in high-end residential and commercial projects. We work with homeowners, general contractors, architects, and interior designers to deliver custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and solid surface solutions.

We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented **Administrative & Project Coordinator** to support our daily office operations, customer communications, purchasing, project scheduling, estimating, and commercial construction bidding activities.

This is a hands-on position ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and helping projects move efficiently from initial inquiry through completion.

**Cabinetry or construction experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train the right candidate.**

Key ResponsibilitiesOffice Administration & Customer Service

* Answer incoming phone calls, respond to emails, and assist customers professionally.
* Make outbound calls to customers, contractors, vendors, and suppliers.
* Schedule customer appointments, field measurements, deliveries, and installations.
* Follow up with customers regarding estimates, project updates, approvals, deposits, and outstanding payments.
* Maintain organized electronic project folders, customer records, and correspondence.
* Prepare documents, spreadsheets, and general office correspondence.
* Assist management with daily administrative and operational tasks.

Operations Coordinator

Morgan Sand & Gravel, LLC

Job Description

Morgan Sand & Gravel, LLC is seeking an experienced, motivated Operations Coordinator to oversee daily operations across our ready-mix concrete, aggregate production, and trucking divisions.

As a central Wisconsin supplier of ready-mix concrete, aggregates, and trucking services, we serve residential, commercial, agricultural, and highway construction customers. We take pride in delivering quality products, dependable service, and maintaining a safe, productive workplace.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who understands the construction materials industry, communicates effectively, and can keep multiple moving parts organized in a fast-paced environment.

Daily Operations & Dispatch

* Coordinate daily concrete, aggregate, and trucking operations to meet production schedules and customer needs.
* Schedule and dispatch concrete mixers, dump trucks, drivers, and hauling resources.
* Direct and coordinate part-time dispatch personnel.
* Monitor delivery schedules, equipment availability, and customer service.
* Work closely with shop, dispatch, and office personnel to maintain efficient operations.

Concrete & Aggregate Production

* Oversee daily ready-mix concrete production and delivery, ensuring product quality and timely service.
* Monitor plant operations and coordinate maintenance to minimize downtime.
* Coordinate aggregate crushing, washing, and production schedules.
* Monitor material inventories and coordinate replenishment as needed.
* Prepare concrete job quotations in coordination with the General Manager.

Fleet & Equipment Management

headlined_rolled.title: Asphalt and Concrete Sr. Estimator

Neyra Paving is a commercial asphalt paving, concrete and pavement maintenance contractor serving the Greater Cincinnati area. Founded in 1965, we have grown into one of Cincinnati's most respected contractors.

We are looking for an Estimator to join our team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a Construction Management, Civil Engineering or related background who is detail-oriented, technically strong and interested in building a career in the construction industry.

**Previous estimating experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train the right person.**

The primary responsibility of this position is to review construction plans and specifications and provide our project managers with accurate quantities and complete scope information.

Our project managers are responsible for final job pricing. Your responsibility is making sure they have accurate information to price the project correctly.

Responsibilities include:

* Review civil/site construction plans, drawings and specifications
* Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for asphalt paving, concrete and related site work
* Calculate areas, lengths, volumes and material quantities
* Identify pavement depths, asphalt mix requirements, concrete specifications and other project requirements
* Review project specifications, details, notes and addenda
* Identify potential scope gaps, unusual requirements and conflicts within the plans
* Prepare clear, organized takeoff packages for project managers
* Communicate questions or concerns discovered during plan review
* Maintain accurate electronic estimating files and documentation
* Work with project managers and field personnel to execute public and private projects
* Occasionally visit jobsites to develop a better understanding of field conditions, construction methods and production

Strong candidates will have:

* Bachelor's or associate degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering T

- You have done commission sales or cold calling before

- You are comfortable walking into a hotel and asking for the general manager

- You have a car and can cover NJ

Pay: $6,000.00 - $15,000.00 per month

#### **WE’RE HIRING: FULL-TIME SALES CONSULTANTS!**

Power Up Construction is growing, and we’re looking for driven, competitive, and motivated individuals ready to build a career in sales!

We’re a local, veteran-owned construction company serving the Upstate of South Carolina. We’re looking for people who want more than just a paycheck — we want team players who are hungry to grow, build relationships, generate business, and get rewarded for their performance!

#### **WHAT WE OFFER**

10% commission with the potential to increase to 12% for top producers

Paid or canvassed leads and labor-only leads start at a 6% commission split

Sales incentives, bonuses, and performance competitions

Team-building events and a competitive team environment

Structured training and guided field experience

Opportunity to grow with an expanding local construction company

#### **YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

Digital canvassing and online outreach

Generating new leads through fieldwork and online marketing

Establishing and managing partnerships with realtors, property managers, builders, and other referral sources

Building and maintaining strong customer relationships

Following up with prospects and helping customers find the right construction solutions

Balancing online prospecting, fieldwork, and partnership development throughout the week

#### **SCHEDULE: MONDAY–FRIDAY**

3 guided field appointments following initial training

#### **Mandatory Friday team meetings**

A weekly mix of digital outreach, field prospecting, appointments, and partnership development

#### **Self-motivated and goal-oriented**

Strong communication and people skills

Competitive mindset with a willingness to learn

#### **Professional, dependable, and organized**

Ready to take ownership of their success

Construction sales experience is a plus, but a strong work ethic, coachability, and the drive to succeed matter most!

headlined_rolled.title: Office manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Title:** Office Manager

**Location:** 401 W Villard St STE 205, Dickinson, ND 58601

**Company:** Prairie Barns Construction LLC

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Salaried

**Compensation:** $45,760/year

### **About Prairie Barns Construction**

At Prairie Barns Construction LLC, we build post-frame buildings and ADUs that endure the elements and serve families, farmers, and small business owners with integrity. Our company culture is built on strong values, attention to detail, and a commitment to doing the right thingeven when it's hard.

### **Position Summary**

We're looking for a dependable, organized, and service-minded **Office Manager** to support our internal teams and ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of our Dickinson office. This role is essential to maintaining a professional and welcoming environment for our staff, clients, and guests.

### **Work Schedule**

* The Office Manager is expected to be **present by 7:00 AM** each workday to open the office, start the coffee, and ensure the space is ready for team members and visitors.
* The position typically ends at **4:00 PM**, Monday through Friday.
* Some team members will remain in the office until 5:00 PM, and the last person out will be responsible for locking up in the evening.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Open the office by 7:00 AM daily; prepare the space, including coffee and climate/lighting comfort
* Maintain a professional front-office environment for guests and employees
* Coordinate scheduling, meetings, and internal events
* Support the executive, operations, and sales teams with administrative tasks
* Maintain organized filing systems (both digital and physical)

headlined_rolled.title: Permitting Coordinator & Scheduler
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Permitting Coordinator to join our dynamic construction team. You will also be responsible for answering phones and scheduling appointments. In this vital role, you will manage the permitting process for various civil engineering and construction projects, ensuring all necessary approvals are obtained efficiently and in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Your expertise will help streamline project timelines, facilitate smooth project execution, and support overall project success. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful infrastructure projects while working closely with project managers, engineers, and regulatory agencies.

**Duties**

* Coordinate and oversee the permitting process for multiple construction projects from initial application through approval, ensuring adherence to all regulatory requirements.
* Prepare and compile permit applications, supporting documentation, and technical reports using construction management.
* Liaise with government agencies, municipalities, and other stakeholders to facilitate permit approvals and resolve any issues that arise during the permitting process.
* Track permit statuses; maintain organized records of all permits, correspondence, and related documentation.
* Collaborate with project teams to review construction plans and ensure they meet permit specifications; assist in updating schedules.
* Monitor project progress to ensure compliance with permit conditions; communicate any changes or delays promptly to relevant parties.
* Answer phones and schedule customer appointments.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of construction industry standards, permitting processes, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication skills for liaising with government agencies, clients, contractors, and internal teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple permits simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

* Construction or restoration industry experience strongly preferred

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Summary**

Scott's Seamless Gutters is an established Lafayette-area gutter company with approximately 30 years in business. We are looking for experienced, self-motivated outside sales representatives who know how to **generate their own leads and close their own sales**.

This is not a position where you sit and wait for leads to be handed to you. We are looking for people who are comfortable prospecting neighborhoods, knocking doors, networking, developing referrals, contacting contractors and property owners, and finding new business.

Experience in roofing, gutters, windows, siding, fencing, solar, HVAC, pest control, or other residential home-improvement sales is a plus.

**What You'll Do**

* Generate your own residential and commercial leads
* Prospect neighborhoods and contact homeowners and businesses
* Build relationships with roofers, contractors, real estate professionals and property managers
* Meet customers at their property
* Measure and evaluate gutter projects
* Prepare estimates using company pricing guidelines
* Follow up with potential customers
* Negotiate and close your own sales
* Maintain professional communication with customers from estimate through sale

**Compensation**

This is a performance-based sales position with **no guaranteed salary or hourly wage**. Your earnings are based on the business you generate and the jobs you successfully sell. Strong producers have the opportunity to earn significantly more by generating and closing more business.

Full details of the compensation structure will be discussed during the interview.

**Who We're Looking For**

We want a **self-starter and closer**, not someone who needs a list of leads every morning. You should be comfortable approaching people, creating opportunities and asking for the sale.

Prior outside sales or home-improvement sales experience is preferred. Gutter experience is helpful but not required. We can teach an experienced salesperson how to estimate gutters.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Serenity is hiring a Construction Estimator to build complete, accurate estimates for commercial and residential projects from about $50,000 to $10 million. · Process weekly payroll across multiple states for several unions including but not limited to Carpenters, Laborers, Tapers, etc.

· Strong understanding of union time and attendance rules as it relates to base wages and fringe benefits.

· Review new hire records ensuring the organization maintains compliance with all applicable state and federal wage and hour laws under multiple union contractual obligations

· Obtain, review, and enter weekly timecards and batches

· Process paper checks as well as direct deposit

· Understanding and familiarity with payroll taxes, benefits, union dues and fringe benefits for unions and prevailing wage areas

· Manage garnishments, 401k deferrals and other payroll related deductions

· Prepare and process timely union payments, payroll tax deposits and required reporting

· Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports for management review

· Perform various journal entries, account reconciliations and general ledger support

**Get into heavy civil estimating with room to grow beyond the junior seat.**

**About Sunset Valley Construction**

We’re a sitework and underground utilities contractor focused on building and maintaining essential infrastructure. We’re projecting to double in size over the next four years and are looking to build out our estimating and preconstruction team to support that growth.

This position is designed for someone earlier in their construction career who has a solid foundation and wants to learn heavy civil estimating, takeoffs, and preconstruction from an experienced team.

**How You’ll Contribute**

As a Junior Estimator / Preconstruction Engineer, you’ll work alongside the owner and estimating/project management team to support the front end of our projects.

You don’t need to walk in knowing how to build a complete heavy civil estimate. You'll use your basic understanding of construction fundamentals, plans, heavy equipment and site construction while we teach you takeoffs, estimating, production rates, pricing, and how real estimates get built before the work reaches the field.

**Growth Opportunity**

This is not intended to be a career-long junior position. As you develop, you’ll take on more complex takeoffs, estimates, and preconstruction responsibilities.

Depending on your strengths and interests, this position can grow toward Estimator, Senior Estimator, Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Project Manager, or Preconstruction Manager. Your growth will be driven by your ability to learn the work, produce accurate information, and become someone the estimating, project management, and field teams can rely on.

* Build a stronger takeoff foundation by learning to perform quantity takeoffs for earthwork, utilities, drainage, site concrete, paving, and other heavy civil/sitework scopes.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Materials Dispatcher/Resource Coordinator
headlined_rolled.desc:
General Responsibilities:

Determines the safest, most efficient way to dispatch employees and/or equipment to project sites. Receives and manages incoming service requests (internal and external) to dispatch appropriately trained staff for the assignment. Dispatchers multitask with strong communication skills, maintaining efficient operations while ensuring that resources are scheduled when requested and directed where they are most needed.

Essential Roles and Responsibilities:

* Answer and manage incoming calls and dispatch employees with appropriate skills or certifications to precise locations at necessary times.

* Skilled at prioritizing projects and managing logistics (equipment, internal logistics) according to urgency and importance, utilizing negotiation skills when conflicts arise.

* Relay information and instruction to employees, their managers, labs and other project stakeholders (internal employees, client, contractors, etc.) as appropriate.

* As the hub for the department or office, maintain communication with field units to coordinate and prioritize schedules day-to-day.

* Dispatch in an incident and injury free manner consistent with Terracon’s guidelines to keep the care and concern of employees a priority.

* Communicate effectively with customers, employees, and leaders.

* Use materials dashboard, CMELMS and other tools to effectively distribute employees and balance workload.

* Perform other office duties, if needed, and work with others to meet deadlines.

* Coordinate between other regional offices to cover projects

* Manage resource conflicts among employees, clients and office/regional leadership team using negotiation strategies.

* Follows safety rules and practices and other safety requirements for all projects. Performs pre-task planning prior to executing work. Report any safety issues or concerns to management.

* Be responsible for maintaining quality standards on all projects.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirement

Dispatcher – Texas Star Plumbers (Magnolia, TX)

ABOUT TEXAS STAR PLUMBERS

Texas Star Plumbers is a locally owned plumbing company based in Magnolia, Texas, serving homeowners and businesses across the north Houston area, including Tomball, Magnolia, The Woodlands, Humble, Atascocita, and Kingwood. We're a growing team that takes pride in honest work, clear communication, and taking care of our customers from the first call to the final invoice.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Dispatcher is the first voice our customers hear and keeps every job moving in Jobber, from the first call to the deposited payment. This role schedules and dispatches our technicians, invoices completed work, and makes sure we get paid.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Dispatching and Scheduling

* Answer incoming calls and the shared company inbox promptly and professionally
* Book, confirm, and reschedule jobs in Jobber, and send appointment reminders
* Assign and dispatch technicians based on job type, location, and availability
* Track job status throughout the day and keep customers updated on arrival times and delays
* Route technical questions to the owner or technicians; return messages the same business day

Invoicing

* Create and send invoices in Jobber after technicians close out jobs
* Confirm job notes, materials, labor, and pricing are complete before an invoice goes out
* Follow up with technicians on missing job details

Collections and Payments

* Take card and online payments and apply them to the correct invoices
* Follow up on unpaid invoices by phone and email on a set schedule
* Maintain a weekly past-due list and flag accounts that need owner attention

Deposits

* Log all checks received and make bank deposits on a set schedule
* Keep deposit slips and payment records organized for reconciliation

Bill Intake

* Collect vendor bills, statements, and receipts as they come in
* Forward them to our outside bookkeeping firm for review and payment

**Marietta, GA | Full-time | Hybrid opportunities**

The Surface Masters is seeking an experienced Estimator to prepare accurate, competitive bids for new construction and municipal asphalt paving projects. This position reports to our Marietta office, with hybrid work opportunities and occasional local site visits.

We’re looking for someone who can interpret plans and specifications, develop thorough cost estimates, and manage multiple bid deadlines while protecting project profitability.
