headlined_rolled.title: Finance & Compliance Manager - Construction Industry
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Note:** This is an early posting for a January or February 2027 opening. However, an earlier start may become necessary.

**About TCE**

TCE is a 40+ person civil and structural subcontractor performing earthwork, utilities, concrete, and site work in the commercial and custom home spaces within the bay area.

**About the role**

The Finance & Compliance Manager owns TCE's financial health and regulatory standing. You'll run accounting and cash management, oversee billing and job costing, and keep insurance, licensing, and bonding current. This is a hands-on role at a growing company: you'll do the work, improve the systems behind it, and give ownership the numbers it needs to make decisions. The back office is already built, with established systems and documented processes, and the role is a chance to take it to the next level with WIP reporting, cash forecasting, and stronger controls. We are looking for someone who can self manage and is also comfortable with task delegation as needed.

**Key responsibilities**

**Accounting and reporting**

* Own the books in QuickBooks Online: New vendor set up (including W9 collection), chart of accounts, job cost allocations, monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
* Prepare the monthly close package: P&L, job cost review, AR aging, AP schedule, and projections
* Build and maintain work-in-progress (WIP) schedules; flag over- and under-billing and margin fade
* Pay and plan for taxes in coordination with CPA
* Coordinate with procurement and project management to keep job costing accurate: cost coding, committed costs, and change orders
* Coordinate with the outside CPA on year-end, tax planning, and financial statements for bonding and credit if needed
* Lead financing efforts for equipment and vehicles
* Maintain fixed asset/purchases register and debt spreadsheet
* Daily treasury management/positive pay ownership

**Cash, payables, and receivables**

* Enter Invoices into Quickbooks
* Approve vendor invoices agains

headlined_rolled.title: Accounting Clerk
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Accounting Clerk**

**Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented **Accounting Clerk** to join our Accounting team. This position is responsible for supporting the day-to-day accounting operations of the company, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, cash management, and various accounting projects. If you enjoy working with numbers, staying organized, solving problems, and being part of a collaborative team, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**

**Accounts Receivable & Cash Management**

* Post receipts and monitor outstanding receivable transactions.
* Prepare bank deposits for payments exceeding scan thresholds.
* Process ACH transactions for intercompany transfers and investor/owner payments.
* Track investor and owner capital contributions.

**Accounts Payable & Accounting Support**

* Prepare, process, and manage accounting upload templates.
* Research and resolve invoice workflow issues within Yardi.
* Assist with invoice entry, payment processing, and payable batch reviews.
* Reconcile credit card statements and resolve discrepancies.
* Monitor invoice approval workflows to ensure timely processing.

**Reconciliations & Reporting**

* Prepare intercompany job billings.
* Complete intercompany balance sheet reconciliations.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation.
* Assist with special accounting projects and other duties as assigned.

**What We're Looking For**

* Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* 2–5 years of accounting experience preferred.
* Experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently while also contributing to a team environment.

headlined_rolled.title: Marketing Coordinator - Property Management
headlined_rolled.desc:
Universe Living is seeking a creative, organized Marketing Coordinator to support marketing and resident engagement across our portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating content, coordinating events, and helping build a positive resident experience.

**What** **you’ll** **do**

* Manage social media, property websites, Google Business Profiles, and Yelp profiles; plan and publish current content highlighting communities, amenities, events, and resident experiences.

* Develop resident communications and marketing materials, including event announcements, calendars, brochures, floor plans, business cards, and name badges. Coordinate resident events, resident welcome gifts, and new employee appreciation gifts.

* Monitor Google reviews, share resident feedback internally, and support timely follow-up.

* Coordinate property visits, photo shoots, and content filming; gather photos and updates to keep marketing materials accurate and engaging.

* Administer the leasing CRM and coordinate internet listing services, including ad package selection and renewal rate negotiations.

* Coordinate marketing projects, timelines, vendors, and administrative details while maintaining a consistent brand across digital channels and community materials.

  

**What** **we’re** **looking for**

* Experience in marketing, social media, communications, event coordination, or a related field.

* Strong writing, organization, and communication skills.

* Familiarity with major social media platforms and Google Business Profile or Google Reviews.

* Ability to create polished content and marketing materials using tools such as Canva.

* Good judgment and a professional, courteous approach to online reviews and resident communications.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

* Property management, residential real estate, or hospitality experience is a plus.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator / Project Coordinator – Residential Remodeling
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Location:** Kenilworth, NJ (travel to job sites throughout Union, Essex, and Morris Counties)  
**Pay:** Based on experience, discussed during interview  
**Job type:** Full-time, Monday to Friday

**About Us**  
UNO Group Home Improvements is a general contractor specializing in residential remodeling. We're growing and looking for an experienced estimator and project coordinator to join our team and keep our projects running smoothly.

* Meet with homeowners, walk the job, take field measurements, and define the scope of work
* Build accurate estimates and proposals from plans and site conditions
* Present pricing to homeowners and help close projects
* Schedule and coordinate our crews and subcontractors
* Be the point of contact for homeowners during construction
* Track timelines and progress, and solve problems before they slow the job down

**What We're Looking For**

* 4+ years of residential construction or remodeling experience
* Estimating experience, plus the ability to read blueprints and plans
* Solid knowledge of construction methods, sequencing, and materials
* Experience coordinating trades and subcontractors
* Comfortable running homeowner meetings on your own
* Organized, accountable, and good at follow-through
* **Spanish required:** you'll communicate daily with our Spanish-speaking crews (English/Spanish bilingual)
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

Pay: $70,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: Sales Representative
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Remodeling Sales Representative (Basements)**  
YMC Construction | Chicago, IL  
Commission: 5% per closed job (You can make $1,000 to $2,500 per job)  
Job type: 1099 Independent Contractor

**About Us**

YMC Construction is a Chicago remodeling company specializing in basement finishing and remodeling. We generate and qualify our own leads, and our crews handle all construction. We're looking for an experienced sales rep to run in-home estimates and close jobs.

**About the Role**

This is a sales only role. You will not do any construction work. Every appointment is pre-booked and pre-qualified by our office team. Your job is to meet the homeowner, assess the space, price the project, and close. Once the contract is signed, our team takes it from there.

**Responsibilities**

* Run in-home estimates for basement remodeling projects
* Measure and scope each project accurately
* Price jobs and present proposals using our CRM
* Answer homeowner questions on design, layout, permits, and timelines
* Follow up with homeowners until a decision is made

**Requirements**

* Proven experience building or selling remodeling projects (required)
* Ability to scope and price a basement remodel on site
* Comfortable selling projects of $20,000 and up
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Comfortable using a smartphone and a CRM
* Located in or near Chicago

**What We Offer**

* 5% commission on every closed job, you can make $1,000 to $2,500 per job
* No cap on earnings
* Pre-booked, pre-qualified appointments
* No construction or project management, just selling
* CRM with built-in estimating tools, proposals, and e-sign contracts
* Office support for appointment reminders and homeowner follow-up
* Flexible schedule

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed and include a short note on your remodeling experience, including the largest project you've sold or built.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

ZAP is a full-service engineering, design, and construction management firm servicing the oil & gas, heavy industrial, mining, and manufacturing sectors.
